generic.Defined scope/population: Earned premium, incurred loss and exposure records for every in-scope line and coverage in the rate review.
generic.In-scope period: The agreed experience period, normally five accident years ending at the review evaluation date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Accident year, coverage, earned premium, paid, case, ALAE and exposure count populated on every extract row.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Extract premium and loss totals tie to the general ledger and statutory exhibits within 0.5 percent.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Extract file and reconciliation tab saved to the rate review folder with run timestamp and version number.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Unreconciled variances and suspect records listed on an exception tab with cause and disposition.
generic.Test population: The full experience-period extract plus the reconciliation tab for each in-scope line.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Premium and loss variance to ledger at or below 0.5 percent and no missing accident-year rows.
generic.Exception handling path: Variances above tolerance are returned to the Data Engineer for re-extract before the data is released.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Extract is accepted when columns are complete, totals reconcile and large losses are flagged.
generic.Evidence location: Rate review SharePoint folder holding the extract, the reconciliation tab and the release note.

steps.title: Confirm experience period and evaluation date from the rate review scope document
sop: Open the approved scope document in SharePoint and read the agreed experience period and evaluation date.
Record the start and end accident years on the data tab of the experience workbook.
Confirm the in-scope lines, states and coverages listed for extraction.
Done when the experience period and evaluation date are written on the data tab.
verify: Check the data tab dates against the scope document.
Pass when the workbook dates match the approved scope exactly.

steps.title: Extract earned premium by accident year from the policy administration system
sop: Run the standard earned premium extract in the policy administration system for the experience period.
Split premium by accident year, coverage and state as required by the review.
Save the raw extract before any manipulation.
Done when earned premium is extracted for every in-scope accident year.
verify: Count accident-year rows returned against the expected period length.
Pass when every accident year in the period has premium rows.

steps.title: Extract paid, case and ALAE losses from the enterprise data warehouse
sop: Run the loss extract in the data warehouse at the agreed evaluation date.
Return paid, case reserve and ALAE as separate columns by accident year and coverage.
Deliver the extract to the actuarial review folder with the query used.
Done when the loss extract with all three components is delivered.
verify: Inspect the extract for the three separate loss columns.
Pass when paid, case and ALAE are present and none are blank.

steps.title: Pull exposure counts for the same period from the data warehouse
sop: Extract car-years, house-years or payroll units matching the premium basis.
Align exposure records to the same accident years and coverages as the premium tab.
Load the exposure extract alongside the premium tab in Excel.
Done when exposure counts are aligned to the premium tab.
verify: Compare the exposure key set to the premium key set.
Pass when every premium row has a matching exposure row.

steps.title: Flag large losses above the per-claim threshold in the Excel experience workbook
sop: Apply the agreed per-claim large-loss threshold to the incurred loss detail.
Mark each qualifying claim in a dedicated large-loss flag column.
List the flagged claims on a separate tab for later capping.
Done when all losses above threshold carry the flag.
verify: Filter the workbook on the flag column and count flagged claims.
Pass when every claim above the threshold is flagged and no claim below it is.

steps.title: Reconcile premium and loss totals to the general ledger in Excel
sop: Build a reconciliation tab comparing extract totals to the ledger and statutory exhibits.
Compute the variance in dollars and percent for premium and for loss.
Note the cause of any variance inside tolerance on the tab.
Done when the reconciliation tab shows premium and loss variances with commentary.
verify: Read the variance percentages on the reconciliation tab.
Pass when both variances are at or below 0.5 percent with the cause noted.

steps.title: Publish the reconciled experience extract to the rate review folder
sop: Review the extract, exposure alignment, large-loss flags and reconciliation tab.
Version the workbook and save it to the rate review SharePoint folder.
Notify the review team that the experience data is released for use.
Done when the versioned workbook is published and the team notified.
verify: Open the published version and confirm all tabs are present.
Pass when the published workbook carries a version number and reconciles.

generic.Defined scope/population: Historical loss experience by coverage that will be trended forward to the proposed policy period.
generic.In-scope period: The experience period being trended and the proposed effective period it is trended to.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Frequency trend, severity trend, trend-from date and trend-to date populated for every coverage.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Trended loss column cross-foots to untrended loss multiplied by the selected trend factor.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Trend exhibit saved with the regression outputs and a version stamp in the review workbook.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Coverages where the selection departs from the fitted trend are logged with the reason.
generic.Test population: Every coverage in the rate review that carries a trend selection.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Selected trend within the range of the 4, 8, 12 and 20 quarter fits or explained in writing.
generic.Exception handling path: Unexplained deviations from the fitted trend are returned to the analyst before the indication runs.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Trend accepted when frequency and severity are selected separately and each selection is justified.
generic.Evidence location: Trend exhibit tab of the rate indication workbook in the rate review SharePoint folder.

steps.title: Assemble quarterly frequency and severity history in the actuarial modeling platform
sop: Load claim counts, exposures and severities by accident quarter and coverage.
Compute frequency per exposure unit and average severity per claim by quarter.
Check for volume breaks caused by product or system change.
Done when a clean quarterly frequency and severity series exists per coverage.
verify: Plot each series and inspect for gaps or step changes.
Pass when every coverage has a continuous quarterly series.

steps.title: Fit exponential and linear regressions over 4, 8, 12 and 20 quarters
sop: Run the regression suite on frequency and on severity separately for each window.
Record the fitted annual trend and the fit statistic for each window.
Tabulate all fits side by side on the trend exhibit.
Done when all four windows are fitted for both frequency and severity.
verify: Count the fitted windows on the trend exhibit per coverage.
Pass when four windows are present for both frequency and severity.

steps.title: Select frequency and severity trends separately per coverage
sop: Compare candidate fits and select a frequency trend and a severity trend for each coverage.
Record the rationale where the selection differs from any fitted window.
Avoid using a single combined pure premium trend.
Done when each coverage carries separate frequency and severity selections.
verify: Read the selection row of the trend exhibit for each coverage.
Pass when no coverage relies on a single combined trend.

steps.title: Cite external trend benchmarks where internal data is thin
sop: Identify coverages where internal volume falls below the credibility threshold for trend.
Pull industry, ISO, CPI medical or auto-parts indices as the external reference.
Record the source and index value next to the selection.
Done when every thin coverage carries a cited external benchmark.
verify: Check each thin-data coverage for a cited benchmark source.
Pass when no thin coverage has an uncited selection.

steps.title: Set trend-from and trend-to dates on the average accident dates
sop: Set trend-from to the average accident date of each historical year.
Set trend-to to the average accident date of the proposed effective period.
Compute the trend period in years to the correct fraction.
Done when every historical year has explicit from and to dates.
verify: Recompute one trend period by hand from the stated dates.
Pass when the manual result matches the workbook trend period.

steps.title: Compute trended losses and cross-foot the exhibit in Excel
sop: Apply the combined frequency and severity trend factor to each historical loss year.
Cross-foot trended loss against untrended loss times the trend factor.
Investigate and correct any row that fails the cross-foot.
Done when every trended loss row cross-foots exactly.
verify: Run the cross-foot check column across all rows.
Pass when all rows return zero difference.

steps.title: Review and release the trend exhibit for use in the indication
sop: Review selections, benchmarks, dates and the cross-foot check.
Sign the trend exhibit and version the workbook.
Release the trended loss column to the indication calculation.
Done when the signed trend exhibit is released.
verify: Confirm the exhibit carries a signature and version.
Pass when the released exhibit is signed and cross-footed.

generic.Defined scope/population: Commission, other acquisition, general expense and taxes licences and fees for the lines under review.
generic.In-scope period: The current plan year expense base used to set the permissible loss ratio for the proposed period.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each expense component, its fixed or variable classification and the profit provision are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Expense components sum to the total expense ratio and reconcile to the general ledger allocation.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Permissible loss ratio exhibit saved with the GL extract date and an exhibit version number.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Movements above one point from the prior review are logged with cause and disposition.
generic.Test population: All expense components and the profit provision feeding the permissible loss ratio.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Permissible loss ratio ties to one minus variable expense minus profit provision with no rounding drift.
generic.Exception handling path: Unexplained expense movements are referred to the Financial Analyst before the exhibit is finalised.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Assessment accepted when components reconcile to the GL and every deviation is explained.
generic.Evidence location: Permissible loss ratio exhibit in the rate indication workbook on the rate review site.

steps.title: Pull the expense allocation for the line from the general ledger
sop: Extract commission, other acquisition, general expense and taxes licences and fees from the ERP ledger.
Apply the documented allocation drivers to attribute expense to the line under review.
Deliver the extract with the allocation basis stated.
Done when the four expense components are extracted and allocated.
verify: Sum the allocated components and compare to the total line expense.
Pass when the components sum to the allocated total.

steps.title: Split expenses into fixed and variable in the Excel exhibit
sop: Classify each expense component as fixed per exposure or variable per premium.
Apply fixed expenses per exposure unit and variable expenses as a percent of premium.
Record any reclassification against the prior review.
Done when every component carries a fixed or variable classification.
verify: Check the classification column for blanks.
Pass when no expense component is left unclassified.

steps.title: Reconcile the target underwriting profit provision to the approved plan
sop: Take the target profit provision from the current-year plan and the board-approved return.
Cite the plan document and approval date on the exhibit.
Confirm the provision used matches the plan figure exactly.
Done when the profit provision is cited and reconciled.
verify: Compare the exhibit provision to the plan document value.
Pass when the two values agree.

steps.title: Compute the permissible loss ratio in the Excel exhibit
sop: Compute one minus variable expense ratio minus profit provision.
Show fixed expense treatment separately from the permissible ratio formula.
Display the resulting permissible loss ratio by line and coverage.
Done when the permissible loss ratio is computed for every in-scope line.
verify: Recompute the permissible ratio from the displayed components.
Pass when the recomputation matches the exhibit value.

steps.title: Compare each component to the prior filed review
sop: Place the prior review expense components alongside the current values.
Compute the change in points for each component and for the permissible ratio.
Flag any component moving more than one point.
Done when the prior comparison column is complete.
verify: Scan the change column for flagged movements.
Pass when every movement above one point carries a flag.

steps.title: Document the cause of each material expense movement
sop: Investigate each flagged movement against commission changes and expense reallocations.
Write the cause next to the flag on the exhibit.
Attach the supporting ledger detail to the workbook.
Done when every flagged movement has a written cause.
verify: Check each flagged row for a written cause.
Pass when no flagged movement is left unexplained.

steps.title: Approve the permissible loss ratio exhibit for use in the indication
sop: Review the components, profit provision, permissible ratio and prior comparison.
Record approval on the exhibit with name and date.
Release the permissible ratio to the indication calculation.
Done when the approval is recorded on the exhibit.
verify: Confirm the exhibit carries an approver name and date.
Pass when the approval block is complete.

generic.Defined scope/population: Model-office risk profiles and competitor rate points across each territory band under review.
generic.In-scope period: The current market position and competitor filings from the last twelve months.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Premium, rank position and competitor identity populated for every model-office profile.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: At least five model-office profiles priced per territory band with no missing competitor quotes.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Benchmark exhibit saved with the rating date and the Earnix run identifier.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Profiles that fail to rate or return outlier premiums are logged with disposition.
generic.Test population: All model-office profiles rated before and after the proposed rate change.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Rank recorded pre and post change for every key segment with no gaps.
generic.Exception handling path: Segments moving outside the target rank band are routed to dislocation review.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Benchmark accepted when pre and post ranks are complete and SERFF filings are cited.
generic.Evidence location: Competitive benchmark exhibit in the rate review folder with the Earnix output attached.

steps.title: Confirm the standard model-office risk profiles for each territory band
sop: Retrieve the standing model-office profile set used for competitive comparison.
Confirm at least five profiles exist per territory band under review.
Add profiles where a band is under-represented.
Done when every territory band has at least five profiles.
verify: Count profiles by territory band.
Pass when no band has fewer than five profiles.

steps.title: Rate the profiles at current rates in Earnix Rating and Pricing
sop: Run each model-office profile through Earnix at the current filed rate level.
Capture the resulting premium for the company and each competitor.
Record the run identifier and rating date.
Done when current-rate premiums are captured for all profiles.
verify: Check for profiles returning no premium.
Pass when every profile returns a premium at current rates.

steps.title: Re-rate the profiles at the proposed rate level in Earnix
sop: Load the proposed rate change into the Earnix scenario.
Re-rate every model-office profile at the proposed level.
Store the post-change premiums alongside the current-rate premiums.
Done when post-change premiums exist for all profiles.
verify: Compare profile counts between the two runs.
Pass when both runs cover the same profile set.

steps.title: Record rank position by premium before and after the change
sop: Rank the company premium against competitors for each profile pre and post change.
Roll ranks up to segment level by territory band.
Show the rank movement for each key segment.
Done when pre and post ranks are recorded for every key segment.
verify: Scan the rank columns for blanks.
Pass when no key segment lacks a pre or post rank.

steps.title: Pull competitor filings for the state and line from SERFF
sop: Search SERFF for competitor rate filings in the same state and line over the last twelve months.
Record the filed change percentage and effective date for each competitor.
Attach the filing references to the benchmark exhibit.
Done when the last twelve months of competitor filings are recorded.
verify: Check the filing list covers the full twelve months.
Pass when each cited filing carries an effective date.

steps.title: Flag segments falling outside the target rank band
sop: Compare the post-change rank of each segment to the target rank band.
Flag every segment that would move outside the band.
Route flagged segments to dislocation review with their premium volume.
Done when all out-of-band segments are flagged and routed.
verify: Check each flagged segment has a dislocation review reference.
Pass when no out-of-band segment is unrouted.

steps.title: Publish the competitive benchmark exhibit to the rate review folder
sop: Assemble ranks, competitor filings and flagged segments into one exhibit.
Version the exhibit and save it to the rate review folder.
Reference the exhibit from the indication memorandum.
Done when the versioned exhibit is published.
verify: Open the published exhibit and confirm all sections are present.
Pass when the exhibit shows pre and post rank plus filing references.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every coverage, territory and class segment receiving an indicated rate change in this review.
generic.In-scope period: The trended and developed experience period feeding the loss ratio method indication.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Trended developed loss and LAE ratio, permissible loss ratio and credibility weight populated per segment.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Premium-weighted segment indications sum to the overall indication within rounding.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Indication exhibit saved with model run identifier and workbook version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Segments failing the roll-up reconciliation are logged with cause and disposition.
generic.Test population: The overall indication and every coverage, territory and class segment indication.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Roll-up difference within rounding tolerance and no segment without a credibility weight.
generic.Exception handling path: Segments lacking credibility documentation are returned for completion before sign-off.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Indication accepted when the method, capping and credibility treatment are consistent throughout.
generic.Evidence location: Indication exhibit in the rate indication workbook on the rate review SharePoint site.

steps.title: Load trended developed losses and on-level premium into the modeling platform
sop: Import the trended loss column and the on-level premium column for the experience period.
Confirm both columns come from the released and signed source exhibits.
Align both to the same segment keys.
Done when trended loss and on-level premium are loaded and aligned.
verify: Check row counts of the two loaded columns.
Pass when both columns cover the identical segment key set.

steps.title: Apply large-loss capping and the excess loss loading consistently
sop: Cap losses at the agreed large-loss threshold in the numerator.
Apply the excess loss loading on the same basis used in the permissible loss ratio.
Confirm the capping basis is identical between numerator and denominator.
Done when capping and loading are applied consistently.
verify: Compare the capping basis stated in both places.
Pass when numerator and denominator use the same capping basis.

steps.title: Compute the overall indication by the loss ratio method
sop: Divide the trended developed loss and LAE ratio by the permissible loss ratio.
Subtract one to give the indicated rate change.
Display the inputs and the result on the indication exhibit.
Done when the overall indicated change is computed and displayed.
verify: Recompute the overall indication from the displayed inputs.
Pass when the recomputation matches the exhibit.

steps.title: Produce indications at coverage, territory and class level
sop: Repeat the loss ratio calculation at each roll-up level.
Show the premium weight used for each segment.
Present the results in one exhibit with a level column.
Done when indications exist at all four levels.
verify: Check each level for missing segments.
Pass when every in-scope segment carries an indication and a weight.

steps.title: Apply credibility weights and identify the complement
sop: Apply the credibility standard to each segment based on claim volume.
Assign the complement of credibility as overall indication or trended present rates.
Record the weight and complement source per segment.
Done when every segment has a weight and a named complement.
verify: Scan the credibility columns for blanks.
Pass when no segment is missing a weight or a complement.

steps.title: Reconcile weighted segment indications to the overall indication
sop: Premium-weight the segment indications and sum them.
Compare the sum to the overall indication.
Investigate and correct any difference beyond rounding.
Done when the roll-up reconciliation is within rounding.
verify: Read the reconciliation difference cell.
Pass when the difference is within the stated rounding tolerance.

steps.title: Review the indication exhibit and release it for committee
sop: Review method, capping, credibility and the roll-up reconciliation.
Record review approval on the exhibit with name and date.
Release the exhibit into the committee pack.
Done when the exhibit is reviewed and released.
verify: Confirm the review block is completed.
Pass when the exhibit carries a reviewer name and date.

generic.Defined scope/population: Earned premium by accident year for each in-scope line together with its full rate change history.
generic.In-scope period: The complete experience period being brought to current rate level.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Rate change percentage, effective date and policy term populated for every historical rate action.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: On-level factor for the current rate level computes to 1.000 exactly.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: On-level worksheet saved with the rate history source and a workbook version stamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Missing or ambiguous rate actions logged with the resolution taken.
generic.Test population: Every rate change in the experience period and every on-level factor produced.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Latest year on-level factor equals 1.000 and no rate action is missing an effective date.
generic.Exception handling path: Gaps in the rate history are referred to the policy administration owner before factors are used.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Factors accepted when the method is stated, the term geometry is correct and off-balance is reflected.
generic.Evidence location: On-level worksheet in the rate indication workbook on the rate review SharePoint site.

steps.title: Extract the full rate change history from the policy administration system
sop: Pull every approved rate change and its effective date covering the experience period.
Include new business and renewal effective dates where they differ.
Record the source and extraction date on the worksheet.
Done when a complete rate change history is loaded.
verify: Check the history for date gaps across the experience period.
Pass when the history covers the period with no unexplained gaps.

steps.title: Record the policy term for each line in the Excel worksheet
sop: Identify whether each line is written on six-month or twelve-month terms.
Record the term against each rate change row.
Reflect the term in the parallelogram geometry setup.
Done when every line carries its policy term.
verify: Check the term column for blanks.
Pass when every line and rate action has a stated term.

steps.title: Select and state the on-level method used
sop: Choose the parallelogram method or extension of exposures based on data availability.
State the chosen method on the worksheet with the reason.
Confirm the method is applied consistently to all lines.
Done when the method is stated and applied consistently.
verify: Read the method statement on the worksheet.
Pass when one method is stated and used throughout.

steps.title: Compute on-level factors by accident year in Excel
sop: Build the cumulative rate level index from the rate change history.
Apply the parallelogram geometry to derive the average rate level for each year.
Divide the current level by each year average to give the on-level factor.
Done when an on-level factor exists for every accident year.
verify: Check each accident year for a computed factor.
Pass when no accident year is missing an on-level factor.

steps.title: Reconcile the current rate level index to 1.000
sop: Confirm the latest year on-level factor computes to 1.000.
Correct the index base where the factor deviates.
Note the reconciliation result on the worksheet.
Done when the current level factor is exactly 1.000.
verify: Read the latest year factor cell.
Pass when the cell equals 1.000.

steps.title: Reflect the off-balance from the last approved change
sop: Identify the off-balance arising from the last approved rate change.
Adjust the rate level index so the effect is not double counted.
Document the off-balance adjustment on the worksheet.
Done when off-balance is reflected and documented.
verify: Compare on-level premium before and after the off-balance adjustment.
Pass when the adjustment is present and explained.

steps.title: Release the on-level premium column to the indication
sop: Review the rate history, method, factors and off-balance treatment.
Version the worksheet and release the on-level premium column.
Notify the indication owner that on-level premium is available.
Done when the on-level premium column is released.
verify: Confirm the released worksheet carries a version and a reviewer.
Pass when the released column reconciles to the factor table.

generic.Defined scope/population: The target return, capital leverage and investment income components building the profit provision.
generic.In-scope period: The current board-approved plan year and the proposed policy effective period.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Target ROE, leverage ratio, payout pattern, investment yield and resulting provision are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: The derived profit provision equals the value used in the rate indication exhibit.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Build-up exhibit saved with the plan approval date and a workbook version stamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any component taken outside the approved plan is logged with approval and disposition.
generic.Test population: Every component of the profit provision build-up for each in-scope line.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Provision in the build-up matches the indication to the stated decimal precision.
generic.Exception handling path: Mismatches between the build-up and the indication are resolved before the memorandum is drafted.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Decomposition accepted when every component is sourced and the contingency load is shown separately.
generic.Evidence location: Profit provision build-up exhibit in the rate indication workbook on the rate review site.

steps.title: Take the target return on equity from the board-approved plan
sop: Retrieve the current board-approved target return on equity for the line.
Record the plan document reference and approval date on the exhibit.
Confirm no superseded plan version is being used.
Done when the target ROE and its approval date are recorded.
verify: Compare the recorded ROE to the plan document.
Pass when the values and the approval date agree.

steps.title: State the premium to surplus leverage ratio for the line
sop: Obtain the allocated capital or premium to surplus ratio for the line.
Cite the capital allocation source on the exhibit.
Confirm the ratio is current for the plan year.
Done when the leverage ratio is stated and sourced.
verify: Check the exhibit for a cited leverage source.
Pass when the ratio carries a named source.

steps.title: Credit investment income using the documented payout pattern
sop: Apply the documented loss payout pattern to derive average reserve duration.
Apply the stated portfolio yield to loss and unearned premium reserves.
Show the investment income credit as a separate line on the exhibit.
Done when the investment income offset is computed and displayed.
verify: Recompute the offset from the shown pattern and yield.
Pass when the recomputation matches the exhibit.

steps.title: Derive the underwriting profit provision in Excel
sop: Convert target ROE to a premium basis using the leverage ratio.
Subtract the investment income credit to give the underwriting profit provision.
Display the full build-up in one column.
Done when the underwriting profit provision is derived.
verify: Recompute the provision from the build-up components.
Pass when the derived provision matches the displayed value.

steps.title: Show any contingency or risk load as a separate line
sop: Identify any contingency or risk load applied to the line.
Present it on its own line rather than inside the profit provision.
State the basis for the load.
Done when the contingency load is shown separately or stated as nil.
verify: Inspect the exhibit for an explicit contingency line.
Pass when the load is either shown separately or explicitly nil.

steps.title: Reconcile the provision to the value used in the indication
sop: Compare the derived provision to the value in the indication exhibit.
Correct either exhibit where a difference exists.
Record the reconciliation result.
Done when the two values agree.
verify: Read the reconciliation cell.
Pass when the difference is zero at the stated precision.

steps.title: Approve the profit provision build-up
sop: Review the ROE source, leverage, investment income and resulting provision.
Record approval with name and date on the exhibit.
Release the provision for use in the indication and memorandum.
Done when approval is recorded on the exhibit.
verify: Confirm the approval block is completed.
Pass when an approver name and date are present.

generic.Defined scope/population: Lines of business, states and coverages included in and excluded from this rate review.
generic.In-scope period: The evaluation date, prior review dates and the target effective date window.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Scope list, evaluation date, target effective date, assigned analyst and reviewer are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Every licensed state writing an in-scope line appears as either included or explicitly excluded.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Scope document versioned and stored in the rate review SharePoint site with the approval date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: States excluded from the review are logged with the reason and a disposition.
generic.Test population: The full state and line matrix considered for this review cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No in-scope state exceeds its statutory maximum interval since the last approved change.
generic.Exception handling path: States nearing the statutory interval are escalated to the Head of Pricing for inclusion.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Scope accepted when owners, dates and exclusions are all explicit and approved.
generic.Evidence location: Approved rate review scope document in the rate review SharePoint folder.

steps.title: List candidate lines, states and coverages in the scope workbook
sop: Build the matrix of licensed states by line and coverage in Excel.
Mark each cell as candidate for review or not applicable.
Circulate the draft matrix to the review team.
Done when the candidate matrix covers every licensed state and line.
verify: Compare the matrix against the licence register.
Pass when no licensed state and line combination is absent.

steps.title: Confirm prior review dates and last approved change per state
sop: Pull the last approved rate change and its date for each state and line.
Compare elapsed time to the statutory review interval.
Flag states approaching or exceeding the interval.
Done when every state carries a prior review date and interval check.
verify: Scan the interval check column for breaches.
Pass when no in-scope state exceeds its statutory interval.

steps.title: Decide inclusions and exclusions with reasons
sop: Decide each candidate cell as in scope or out of scope.
Record an explicit reason for every exclusion.
Confirm the decision with the Insurance Product Manager.
Done when every cell has an in or out decision with a reason for exclusions.
verify: Check exclusions for a stated reason.
Pass when no exclusion is left unexplained.

steps.title: Set the target effective date from filing lead times
sop: Take the state filing lead time and the policy system release calendar.
Back-plan the target effective date for new and renewal business.
Record both dates on the scope document.
Done when target effective dates are set for new and renewal business.
verify: Compare the target date against the longest state lead time.
Pass when the target date allows for the longest lead time.

steps.title: Agree and record the data evaluation date
sop: Agree a single valuation date all analysts will use.
Record the evaluation date prominently on the scope document.
Communicate the date to the data and reserving teams.
Done when the evaluation date is recorded and communicated.
verify: Check the scope document for a single stated evaluation date.
Pass when only one evaluation date appears.

steps.title: Assign named analyst and reviewer per line with due dates
sop: Assign a preparing analyst and an independent reviewer to each line.
Set due dates back-planned from the target effective date.
Publish the assignment table on the review plan.
Done when every in-scope line has an analyst, a reviewer and a due date.
verify: Scan the assignment table for blanks.
Pass when no in-scope line lacks an owner or a due date.

steps.title: Approve and publish the rate review scope document
sop: Review scope, dates, assignments and exclusions.
Record approval with name and date on the cover page.
Publish the versioned document to the rate review SharePoint site.
Done when the approved scope document is published.
verify: Open the published document and check the approval block.
Pass when the published version carries approval and a version number.

generic.Defined scope/population: Paid and incurred loss triangles by coverage feeding the loss development factor selections.
generic.In-scope period: The experience period triangles evaluated at the agreed review evaluation date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Accident period, development age, paid, incurred and link ratio populated in every triangle cell.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Latest diagonal of each triangle ties to the aggregate loss total for the same evaluation date.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: LDF exhibit saved with the triangle evaluation date and modeling platform run identifier.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Excluded outlier link ratios logged on the triangle with the reason for exclusion.
generic.Test population: Every coverage triangle and its selected age-to-age and tail factors.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Latest diagonal reconciles to the aggregate loss total and every selection has a stated basis.
generic.Exception handling path: Differences from the reserving selections are escalated to the Reserving Actuary for agreement.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Factors accepted when candidate averages, selections, tail basis and reserving comparison are all shown.
generic.Evidence location: LDF exhibit in the rate indication workbook with the modeling platform output attached.

steps.title: Build paid and incurred triangles at the agreed evaluation date
sop: Construct paid and incurred triangles by accident period and development age.
Use the same evaluation date for both triangles.
Reconcile the latest diagonal to the aggregate loss total.
Done when both triangles are built and reconciled.
verify: Compare the latest diagonal sum to the aggregate loss total.
Pass when the two agree within the stated tolerance.

steps.title: Compute age-to-age factors and candidate averages
sop: Compute link ratios for every development interval.
Produce volume-weighted, simple, latest-three and latest-five year averages.
Display all candidates on the triangle exhibit.
Done when all candidate averages are computed and displayed.
verify: Check each development interval for the four candidate averages.
Pass when every interval shows all candidates.

steps.title: Exclude outlier link ratios driven by known large losses
sop: Identify link ratios distorted by known large losses.
Exclude those cells and annotate the triangle with the reason.
Recompute candidate averages after exclusion.
Done when every exclusion is applied and annotated.
verify: Check each excluded cell for an annotation.
Pass when no exclusion is unannotated.

steps.title: Select age-to-age factors in the actuarial modeling platform
sop: Select a factor for each development interval from the candidate set.
Record the basis for each selection.
Store the selection set against the model run.
Done when every interval carries a selected factor with a basis.
verify: Scan the selection row for blanks.
Pass when no development interval is missing a selection.

steps.title: Select the tail factor and state its basis
sop: Choose the tail factor from curve fit, industry benchmark or the reserving tail.
State the basis explicitly on the exhibit.
Quantify the impact of the tail on the indicated ultimate.
Done when the tail factor and its quantified impact are recorded.
verify: Read the tail basis and impact cells.
Pass when both the basis and the impact are stated.

steps.title: Compare pricing selections against the reserving selections
sop: Place the reserving team selections alongside the pricing selections.
Identify every deliberate difference and its rationale.
Confirm or challenge each difference in writing.
Done when every difference carries an agreed rationale.
verify: Check the comparison table for unexplained differences.
Pass when no difference is left without a rationale.

steps.title: Release the selected LDFs into the indication
sop: Confirm the comparison is complete and differences are agreed.
Version the LDF exhibit and record the confirmation.
Release the selected factors to the indication calculation.
Done when the LDF exhibit is confirmed and released.
verify: Confirm the exhibit shows a reserving comparison and a confirmation.
Pass when the released exhibit carries both.

generic.Defined scope/population: All assumptions, exhibits, reliances and limitations supporting the rate indication being documented.
generic.In-scope period: The experience period, evaluation date and the proposed effective period covered by the indication.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Data sources, each key assumption with rationale, reliances and the signer block are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Every figure quoted in the memorandum traces to the released indication workbook.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Signed memorandum stored in the document repository with version and signature date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Known data limitations recorded with their effect on the indication and the disposition taken.
generic.Test population: The complete memorandum including assumption, sensitivity and reliance sections.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No key assumption without a stated selection and rationale and no untraceable figure.
generic.Exception handling path: Missing rationale or untraceable figures are returned to the preparer before signature.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Memorandum accepted when certification language and a qualified signer are present per ASOP.
generic.Evidence location: Document management repository record for the signed rate indication memorandum.

steps.title: State data sources, evaluation date and experience period in the memorandum
sop: Write the data source systems, evaluation date and experience period into the opening section.
List any data limitation known at the time of the review.
Reference the released experience extract by version.
Done when sources, dates and limitations are stated.
verify: Check the opening section for each required element.
Pass when source, date, period and limitations all appear.

steps.title: Record each key assumption with its selection and rationale
sop: Document trend, LDF, expense, profit provision and credibility selections.
Write the rationale for each selection alongside the value.
Cross-reference the supporting exhibit for each assumption.
Done when every key assumption has a value, rationale and exhibit reference.
verify: Scan the assumption table for missing rationale.
Pass when no assumption lacks a rationale or a reference.

steps.title: Insert the sensitivity table from the sensitivity analysis
sop: Import the indication results under alternative trend and LDF selections.
Present the base case alongside each flexed scenario.
Comment on which assumption drives the largest swing.
Done when the sensitivity table is included with commentary.
verify: Check the table includes a base case and flexed scenarios.
Pass when both are present with commentary.

steps.title: Disclose reliances on other parties by name and scope
sop: List reliance on reserving, finance and vendor models by name.
State the scope of each reliance and what was not independently verified.
Confirm each named party is aware of the reliance.
Done when every reliance is named and scoped.
verify: Check each reliance entry for a name and scope.
Pass when no reliance is stated generically.

steps.title: Trace every quoted figure to the released indication workbook
sop: Cross-check each number in the memorandum against the workbook cell.
Correct any figure that does not trace.
Record the workbook version used for tracing.
Done when every figure traces to the workbook.
verify: Sample the memorandum figures against the workbook.
Pass when the sampled figures all trace correctly.

steps.title: Add certification language and identify the qualified signer
sop: Insert the actuarial certification language required by ASOP.
Name the signing actuary and confirm the qualification standard is met.
Prepare the signature block with a date field.
Done when certification language and signer identification are in place.
verify: Read the certification section for signer and qualification.
Pass when both appear and the qualification is stated.

steps.title: Review and file the signed memorandum in the repository
sop: Review the memorandum for completeness against the checklist.
Obtain signature and record the signature date.
File the signed memorandum in the document management repository.
Done when the signed memorandum is filed.
verify: Open the repository record and confirm the signature and date.
Pass when the filed memorandum is signed and versioned.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every state, line and coverage indication being put forward for approval in this review cycle.
generic.In-scope period: The review cycle from peer review completion to the recorded sign-off date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Approved percentage, state, line, coverage, approver and sign-off date populated on the record.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Signed-off indication count equals the number of state and line combinations in the review scope.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Sign-off record stored in SharePoint with the indication workbook version it approves.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Selected changes that override the actuarial indication logged with rationale and disposition.
generic.Test population: All indications in the review scope and their corresponding sign-off entries.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No downstream filing or rating work begins on an indication without a recorded sign-off.
generic.Exception handling path: Indications without completed peer review are returned before sign-off is requested.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Sign-off accepted when peer review is attached and every override carries a business rationale.
generic.Evidence location: Rate review sign-off record in SharePoint linked to the document repository memorandum.

steps.title: Complete the peer review checklist for each indication
sop: Work the standard peer review checklist against each state and line indication.
Record findings and their resolution on the checklist.
Attach the completed checklist to the sign-off request.
Done when a completed checklist exists for every indication.
verify: Count completed checklists against indications in scope.
Pass when every indication has an attached checklist.

steps.title: Assemble the sign-off pack in SharePoint
sop: Collect the indication exhibit, memorandum and peer review checklist.
Load them into the sign-off folder for the review cycle.
Record the workbook version being approved.
Done when the sign-off pack is assembled and versioned.
verify: Open the folder and check all three artefacts are present.
Pass when the pack is complete and versioned.

steps.title: Record the approved percentage per state, line and coverage
sop: Enter the approved change percentage for each state, line and coverage.
Compare each entry to the indicated value from the exhibit.
Leave no scope combination blank.
Done when every scope combination carries an approved percentage.
verify: Scan the sign-off table for blank percentages.
Pass when no scope combination is blank.

steps.title: Record any override of the actuarial indication with rationale
sop: Identify rows where the selected change differs from the indicated change.
Write the business rationale and the accepted adequacy gap for each.
Flag the row as an override on the record.
Done when every override carries a rationale.
verify: Filter the record on override rows.
Pass when no override lacks a written rationale.

steps.title: Obtain Chief Actuary sign-off on the pack
sop: Review the peer review checklist, indications and overrides.
Record sign-off with name and date on the record.
Note any conditions attached to the approval.
Done when sign-off is recorded with name and date.
verify: Check the record for an approver name and date.
Pass when both are present.

steps.title: Confirm the sign-off date precedes downstream work
sop: Compare the sign-off date to the start dates of filing and rating tasks.
Halt any downstream task started ahead of sign-off.
Record the confirmation on the sign-off record.
Done when the date sequence is confirmed.
verify: Compare downstream task start dates to the sign-off date.
Pass when no downstream task predates sign-off.

steps.title: Publish the sign-off record and release the indications
sop: Publish the signed record to the rate review SharePoint site.
Notify filing and product owners that indications are released.
Link the record to the indication memorandum.
Done when the record is published and owners notified.
verify: Open the published record and follow the memorandum link.
Pass when the record is published and correctly linked.

generic.Defined scope/population: Trend, loss development, tail, expense, profit provision and experience period length assumptions.
generic.In-scope period: The same experience period and evaluation date as the locked base case indication.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Flexed value, resulting indication and difference from base populated for every scenario row.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Base case row in the sensitivity table equals the released indication exactly.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Sensitivity exhibit saved with the base case workbook version and model run identifier.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Scenarios that fail to run or produce implausible results logged with disposition.
generic.Test population: All flexed scenarios across trend, LDF, tail, expense and experience period length.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Base case reproduces the released indication and every planned scenario is present.
generic.Exception handling path: Scenarios that do not reproduce the base case are rerun before results are published.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Sensitivities accepted when a ranked driver table identifies the largest swing assumption.
generic.Evidence location: Sensitivity exhibit tab of the rate indication workbook on the rate review site.

steps.title: Lock the base case indication in the modeling platform
sop: Copy the released indication run as the immutable base case.
Record its model run identifier and workbook version.
Confirm the base case reproduces the released indicated change.
Done when the base case is locked and reproduces the release.
verify: Compare the base case output to the released indication.
Pass when the two match exactly.

steps.title: Flex trend by plus and minus one point and record the result
sop: Run the indication with trend increased by one point and again decreased by one point.
Record the indicated change for each run.
Compute the difference from the base case.
Done when both trend scenarios are recorded.
verify: Check the table for both trend scenarios.
Pass when both up and down scenarios are present with differences.

steps.title: Flex selected LDFs and the tail to the candidate high and low
sop: Substitute the highest and lowest candidate averages for the selected LDFs.
Run the tail factor at its high and low alternatives.
Record each resulting indication.
Done when LDF and tail scenarios are recorded.
verify: Check the table for LDF and tail scenarios at both extremes.
Pass when four development scenarios are present.

steps.title: Flex expense ratio and profit provision to the plan high and low
sop: Run the indication with the expense ratio at plan high and plan low.
Repeat with the profit provision at its high and low.
Show the expense and profit effects separately.
Done when expense and profit scenarios are recorded separately.
verify: Check that expense and profit effects appear on separate rows.
Pass when the two effects are not combined.

steps.title: Test alternative experience period lengths
sop: Rerun the indication using a three year and a five year experience period.
Keep all other assumptions at base case values.
Record the indication difference for each length.
Done when both alternative period lengths are tested.
verify: Check the table for both period length scenarios.
Pass when both appear with differences from base.

steps.title: Produce a ranked driver table in Excel
sop: Rank all scenarios by absolute indication swing.
Present the ranking as a tornado or ranked table.
Name the assumption driving the largest swing.
Done when the ranked driver table is produced.
verify: Read the top row of the ranked table.
Pass when the largest driver is identified explicitly.

steps.title: Publish the sensitivity exhibit for the memorandum
sop: Assemble scenarios, base case and ranked table into one exhibit.
Version the exhibit and save it to the rate review folder.
Reference it from the rate indication memorandum.
Done when the exhibit is published and referenced.
verify: Follow the memorandum reference to the exhibit.
Pass when the reference resolves to the published exhibit.

generic.Defined scope/population: All states and lines with a recommended rate change being taken to the Pricing Committee.
generic.In-scope period: The review cycle and the proposed effective period for the recommended changes.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Indicated change, recommended change, premium impact and dislocation populated per state and line.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Premium impact in the deck reconciles to the indication workbook premium base.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Committee deck versioned in SharePoint and minutes filed against the same review cycle.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Gaps between indicated and recommended change logged with rationale and committee disposition.
generic.Test population: Every state and line presented plus the committee decision recorded for each.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No presented change without a stated premium impact and dislocation distribution.
generic.Exception handling path: Items the committee defers are recorded with an owner and a return date.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Presentation accepted when the minutes capture decision, effective date and conditions.
generic.Evidence location: Pricing Committee minutes and deck in the SharePoint committee library.

steps.title: Build the indicated versus recommended view in the committee deck
sop: Show indicated and recommended change side by side for each state and line.
Explain the gap wherever the two differ.
Order the slides by premium volume.
Done when every state and line shows both values with an explanation.
verify: Scan the deck for rows missing an explanation.
Pass when every gap is explained.

steps.title: Quantify premium and policy count impact in Excel
sop: Apply the recommended change to the in-force book to compute premium impact.
Show the affected policy count alongside premium.
Reconcile the premium base to the indication workbook.
Done when premium and policy impact are computed and reconciled.
verify: Compare the deck premium base to the indication workbook.
Pass when the two bases agree.

steps.title: Produce the dislocation distribution in Power BI
sop: Bucket policyholder premium changes into impact bands.
Report the share of policyholders above a ten percent increase.
Show the maximum increase for each state.
Done when the dislocation distribution is produced for every state.
verify: Check each state has a dislocation chart.
Pass when no state is missing its distribution.

steps.title: Include competitive rank before and after the change
sop: Import the pre and post change rank from the competitive benchmark exhibit.
Present rank movement for each key segment.
Note segments that move outside the target band.
Done when rank movement is shown for all key segments.
verify: Compare the deck ranks to the benchmark exhibit.
Pass when the deck ranks match the exhibit.

steps.title: State retention and volume risk as a quantified range
sop: Estimate retention loss under the recommended change using historical elasticity.
Express the result as a low to high range rather than a point.
State the assumptions behind the range.
Done when a quantified retention and volume range is stated.
verify: Read the range slide for stated assumptions.
Pass when the range and its assumptions both appear.

steps.title: Present the recommendation to the Pricing Committee
sop: Walk the committee through indications, recommendations, impacts and risks.
Take questions and note challenges raised.
Request a decision per state and line.
Done when the committee has heard the full recommendation.
verify: Check the attendance and agenda record.
Pass when the session is recorded as held with a quorum.

steps.title: Record the decision, effective date and conditions in the minutes
sop: Write the committee decision for each state and line into the minutes.
Record the approved effective date and any conditions.
File the minutes with the deck in the committee library.
Done when the minutes are filed with decisions and conditions.
verify: Open the filed minutes and check every presented item has a decision.
Pass when no presented item is left without a decision.

generic.Defined scope/population: Approved indications for every state, line, coverage and segment being handed to Product Management.
generic.In-scope period: From committee approval to the confirmed acknowledgement of the handoff.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: State, line, coverage, selected percentage and target effective dates populated per row.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Row count in the handoff file equals the approved rows on the sign-off record.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Handoff file versioned in SharePoint with the acknowledgement stored beside it.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Rows Product Management queries are logged with the query and its resolution.
generic.Test population: The full approved indication file and the acknowledgement record.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every approved row is present in the handoff file and acknowledgement is recorded.
generic.Exception handling path: Discrepancies against the sign-off record are corrected and the file reissued.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Handoff accepted when rate, rule and form changes are itemised and receipt is acknowledged.
generic.Evidence location: Handoff record in the rate review SharePoint folder with the acknowledgement email attached.

steps.title: Build the approved change file in Excel from the sign-off record
sop: Export the approved percentages by state, line, coverage and segment.
Structure one row per approved combination with no merged cells.
Reconcile the row count to the sign-off record.
Done when the change file matches the sign-off record row for row.
verify: Compare row counts between file and sign-off record.
Pass when the counts are equal.

steps.title: Itemise the rate, rule and form changes required
sop: List each rate page, rule and form change needed to implement the approved changes.
Reference the source exhibit for each item.
Group the items by state and line.
Done when every implementation item is listed and referenced.
verify: Check items for a source reference.
Pass when no item lacks a reference.

steps.title: State target effective dates for new and renewal business
sop: Record the new business effective date and the renewal effective date separately.
Confirm the dates against the committee-approved effective date.
Note any state where the dates differ and why.
Done when both dates appear for every row.
verify: Scan the date columns for blanks.
Pass when both dates are populated on every row.

steps.title: Publish the handoff pack to SharePoint
sop: Save the change file, implementation item list and approval reference to the handoff folder.
Version the pack with the review cycle identifier.
Restrict edit access to the pricing team.
Done when the versioned handoff pack is published.
verify: Open the folder and confirm all three artefacts are present.
Pass when the pack is complete and versioned.

steps.title: Notify Product Management by email and Teams
sop: Send the handoff notification with the SharePoint link and a summary of scope.
Name the pricing contact for queries.
Request written acknowledgement of receipt.
Done when the notification has been sent.
verify: Check the sent item for the link and the acknowledgement request.
Pass when both are present in the notification.

steps.title: Review the handoff pack against the approved indications
sop: Open the change file and check the scope against the approval reference.
Raise queries on any row that is unclear or missing.
Confirm the implementation items are actionable.
Done when the pack has been reviewed and queries raised.
verify: Check the query log for open unanswered items.
Pass when every raised query has a response.

steps.title: Record the Product Management acknowledgement with the handoff
sop: Send written acknowledgement of receipt and acceptance.
Store the acknowledgement in the handoff folder.
Update the handoff record status to confirmed.
Done when the acknowledgement is stored and the status updated.
verify: Open the handoff record and read the status.
Pass when the status is confirmed and the acknowledgement is attached.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every candidate rating variable level being tested for credibility and internal homogeneity.
generic.In-scope period: The modelling data window used to fit the rating model relativities.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Exposure, claim count, credibility weight and complement source populated for each level.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Exposure and claim counts by level sum to the modelling dataset totals.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Credibility exhibit saved with the SAS run identifier and the merge mapping table.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Levels merged for low volume logged with the merge rule and disposition.
generic.Test population: All levels of all candidate variables entering the model.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No level below the full credibility standard is used without a weight and a complement.
generic.Exception handling path: Levels failing homogeneity are split or regrouped before relativities are finalised.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Tests accepted when pre and post credibility relativities are shown side by side.
generic.Evidence location: Credibility exhibit and merge mapping table stored with the model in the governance repository.

steps.title: Compute exposure and claim counts by level in SAS
sop: Aggregate exposure and claim counts for every level of every candidate variable.
Reconcile the totals to the modelling dataset.
Output the counts to the credibility exhibit.
Done when counts exist for every level and reconcile to the dataset.
verify: Compare the summed level counts to the dataset totals.
Pass when the totals agree.

steps.title: Apply the full credibility standard to each level
sop: State the full credibility claim count standard being used.
Compare each level claim count to the standard.
Flag levels falling below full credibility.
Done when every level is tested against the standard.
verify: Check the flag column against the counts.
Pass when every level below the standard is flagged.

steps.title: Merge low-volume levels and save the mapping table
sop: Group flagged low-volume levels using the agreed merge rule.
Record the original to merged level mapping in a table.
Save the mapping table with the model artefacts.
Done when all merges are applied and mapped.
verify: Check each merged level appears in the mapping table.
Pass when no merge is undocumented.

steps.title: Test homogeneity within each proposed level
sop: Compute loss ratio spread across sub-levels inside each proposed level.
Compare the spread to the agreed tolerance.
Flag levels that fail the homogeneity test.
Done when every proposed level has a homogeneity result.
verify: Scan the homogeneity column for missing results.
Pass when every level carries a tested result.

steps.title: Identify the complement of credibility for each partial level
sop: Choose a complement for each partially credible level.
Record the complement source alongside the level.
Confirm the complement is itself credible.
Done when every partially credible level names a complement.
verify: Check partial levels for a named complement.
Pass when no partial level lacks a complement.

steps.title: Apply credibility weights and show pre and post relativities
sop: Weight each level relativity against its complement.
Display the raw and credibility-weighted relativity side by side.
Confirm weights lie between zero and one.
Done when weighted relativities are displayed for every level.
verify: Inspect the weight column bounds and the paired columns.
Pass when all weights are in range and both columns are populated.

steps.title: Publish the credibility exhibit to the governance repository
sop: Assemble counts, standard, weights, complements and merge mapping into one exhibit.
Store the exhibit with the model record.
Reference it from the model documentation.
Done when the exhibit is stored and referenced.
verify: Follow the documentation reference to the exhibit.
Pass when the reference resolves and the exhibit is complete.

generic.Defined scope/population: The modelling dataset records feeding the frequency and severity generalized linear models.
generic.In-scope period: The agreed training data window ending at the model evaluation date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Exposure offset, claim count, claim severity and every predictor populated on modelled records.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Modelled exposure and claim counts reconcile to the prepared modelling dataset totals.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Fitted model artefacts saved with SAS run identifier, model spec and diagnostic outputs.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Non-significant levels dropped or grouped are logged with the test statistic and disposition.
generic.Test population: Both fitted components plus the combined pure premium and the Tweedie cross-check.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Coefficient tables, significance statistics and residual diagnostics present for both components.
generic.Exception handling path: Components failing diagnostics are refitted before relativities are taken forward.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Model accepted when form, link and offset are recorded and the Tweedie cross-check reconciles.
generic.Evidence location: Model artefact folder in the governance repository holding spec, coefficients and diagnostics.

steps.title: Fit the frequency model with Poisson and log link in SAS
sop: Fit claim counts with a Poisson distribution and log link.
Include earned exposure as the model offset.
Output the coefficient table and fit statistics.
Done when the frequency model is fitted with the exposure offset.
verify: Check the model output for the offset term and link function.
Pass when both are recorded as specified.

steps.title: Fit the severity model with Gamma and log link in SAS
sop: Fit average claim severity with a Gamma distribution and log link.
Weight the fit by claim count.
Output the coefficient table and fit statistics.
Done when the severity model is fitted and weighted by claim count.
verify: Check the severity output for the claim count weight.
Pass when the weight is present in the model specification.

steps.title: Record model form, link and offset in the model spec
sop: Write the distribution, link function, offset and weight for each component.
Record the software version and run identifier.
Store the spec with the model artefacts.
Done when the model spec documents both components fully.
verify: Read the spec for both components.
Pass when distribution, link, offset and weight all appear.

steps.title: Review parameter significance and group or drop weak levels
sop: Review p-values and chi-square statistics for every parameter.
Group or drop levels that are not significant.
Log each change with its test statistic.
Done when all non-significant levels are grouped, dropped or justified.
verify: Check the change log against the coefficient table.
Pass when every retained weak level carries a justification.

steps.title: Produce residual and deviance diagnostics for both components
sop: Generate residual plots and deviance statistics for frequency and severity.
Review for systematic patterns or heavy tails.
Attach the diagnostic output to the model artefacts.
Done when diagnostics exist and have been reviewed for both components.
verify: Open the diagnostic output for each component.
Pass when both components have reviewed diagnostics.

steps.title: Combine frequency and severity into pure premium relativities
sop: Multiply the fitted frequency and severity relativities by level.
Produce the combined pure premium relativity table.
Rebase the table to the chosen base cell.
Done when combined pure premium relativities are produced.
verify: Check the base cell relativity value.
Pass when the base cell equals 1.000.

steps.title: Cross-check the combined result against a Tweedie fit
sop: Fit a direct Tweedie pure premium model on the same data.
Compare its relativities to the combined frequency and severity result.
Explain any material divergence by variable.
Done when the cross-check comparison is complete.
verify: Read the comparison table for unexplained divergences.
Pass when every material divergence carries an explanation.

generic.Defined scope/population: The test case pack of representative risks covering every rating variable level in the release.
generic.In-scope period: The UAT window between build completion and the production release decision.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Expected premium, actual premium, variance and result populated for every test case.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Executed test case count equals the planned pack count with no skipped cases.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: UAT pack saved with the build version tested and the execution timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Every premium difference logged as a defect with severity and disposition.
generic.Test population: At least fifty representative risks plus the boundary cases in the pack.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Rated premium matches the actuarial calculator to the cent on every case.
generic.Exception handling path: Failing cases are raised as defects to the Business Systems Analyst and retested after fix.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: UAT accepted when no severity one rating defect is open and pricing has signed off.
generic.Evidence location: UAT pack and sign-off stored with the release record in the project SharePoint folder.

steps.title: Build the test case pack covering every rating variable level
sop: Design at least fifty representative risks spanning all rating variable levels.
Compute the expected premium for each in the Excel actuarial calculator.
Store the pack with the expected results locked.
Done when the pack covers every level with an expected premium.
verify: Cross-tabulate the pack against the rating variable level list.
Pass when every level appears in at least one case.

steps.title: Add boundary cases to the pack
sop: Add minimum premium, maximum discount stacking, territory edge and new versus renewal cases.
Compute expected premiums for each boundary case.
Mark them as boundary cases in the pack.
Done when all four boundary categories are present.
verify: Filter the pack on boundary cases.
Pass when each boundary category has at least one case.

steps.title: Execute the pack in Guidewire PolicyCenter
sop: Enter or load each test risk into the PolicyCenter UAT environment.
Capture the rated premium for each case.
Record the build version under test.
Done when every case has a rated premium recorded.
verify: Count executed cases against the pack size.
Pass when no case is left unexecuted.

steps.title: Compare rated premium to the actuarial calculator to the cent
sop: Place the rated premium next to the expected premium for each case.
Compute the variance in cents.
Flag every non-zero variance for investigation.
Done when every case carries a computed variance.
verify: Scan the variance column.
Pass when all variances are zero or flagged as defects.

steps.title: Confirm rounding and order of operations against the approved rate order
sop: Trace one case step by step through the rating algorithm in Earnix and PolicyCenter.
Confirm factor order, discount sequence and rounding points match the approved order.
Record the trace on the UAT pack.
Done when the algorithm trace is recorded and matches.
verify: Compare the trace to the approved rate order document.

generic.Defined scope/population: All field underwriters required to apply the revised guideline version.
generic.In-scope period: From publication to the guideline effective date for new and renewal business.

generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No superseded guideline version remains available as current in the repository.
generic.Exception handling path: Outstanding acknowledgements are escalated to the team manager before the effective date.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Communication accepted when a briefing is delivered to each team before the effective date.
generic.Evidence location: Controlled guideline repository record with the change summary and acknowledgement log.

steps.title: Publish the approved guideline to the controlled repository
sop: Upload the approved guideline to the document management repository.
Put the version number and effective date on the cover page.
Set the document as the current controlled version.
Done when the guideline is published as the current version.
verify: Open the repository entry and read the cover page.
Pass when version and effective date are both shown.

steps.title: Withdraw superseded versions from current status
sop: Identify prior versions still marked current.
Move them to superseded status with a retention note.
Confirm search returns only the new version as current.
Done when no superseded version remains current.
verify: Search the repository for the guideline.
Pass when only one version is returned as current.

steps.title: Issue the section-by-section change summary
sop: List each change against the prior version by section.
State what changed and why for each entry.
Attach the summary to the published guideline.
Done when the change summary covers every amended section.
verify: Compare the summary against a tracked-change diff.
Pass when every amended section appears in the summary.

steps.title: State effective dates for new, renewal and in-flight business
