State how in-flight submissions are treated.
Publish the dates on the cover page and in the change summary.
Done when all three treatments are stated.
verify: Read the effective date section.
Pass when new, renewal and in-flight treatments all appear.

steps.title: Deliver a briefing or recorded walkthrough to each team
sop: Schedule a briefing for each underwriting team before the effective date.
Record the session for underwriters who cannot attend.
Log attendance per team.
Done when every team has received a briefing or recording.
verify: Compare briefed teams to the team list.
Pass when no team is unbriefed before the effective date.

steps.title: Capture read-and-acknowledge per underwriter
sop: Issue the acknowledgement request through Teams and email.
Track acknowledgement status per underwriter.
Chase outstanding acknowledgements to completion.
Done when every underwriter has acknowledged or been escalated.
verify: Read the acknowledgement log completion rate.
Pass when the outstanding list is empty or escalated.

steps.title: Confirm communication complete before the effective date
sop: Review publication, change summary, briefings and acknowledgements.
Record confirmation that communication is complete.
Escalate any gap ahead of the effective date.
Done when the confirmation is recorded.
verify: Compare the confirmation date to the effective date.
Pass when confirmation precedes the effective date.

generic.Defined scope/population: Current guideline rules, their written intent and the exceptions applied in practice.
generic.In-scope period: The last twelve months of exception logs and underwriting practice.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Rule reference, written intent, applied practice and reported problem populated per rule.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Rules consulted on cover the full current guideline rule set.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Consultation notes saved in SharePoint with the session dates and participants listed.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Frequently used exceptions logged with their business justification and disposition.
generic.Test population: Every rule in the current guideline plus the twelve month exception log.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every rule has both its written intent and its applied practice captured.
generic.Exception handling path: Rules reported as unworkable are routed for removal or rewrite in the drafting step.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Input accepted when participants confirm the notes are an accurate record.
generic.Evidence location: Consultation record in the underwriting guideline folder on SharePoint.

steps.title: Extract the current guideline rule set for consultation
sop: List every rule in the current guideline with its section reference.
Record the written intent as stated in the document.
Circulate the list ahead of the sessions.
Done when the full rule set is listed with written intent.
verify: Compare the list to the guideline document sections.
Pass when no section rule is missing.

steps.title: Pull the last twelve months of exception logs
sop: Extract logged underwriting exceptions for the last twelve months.
Rank exceptions by frequency and premium volume.
Attach the ranked list to the consultation pack.
Done when the exception log is extracted and ranked.
verify: Check the log covers a full twelve months.
Pass when the date range is complete.

steps.title: Compare written intent against actual application
sop: Describe how each rule is applied in practice.
Note where practice differs from the written intent.
Record the reason for each divergence.
Done when practice is captured for every rule.
verify: Scan the practice column for blanks.
Pass when every rule has a practice description.

steps.title: Capture business justification for common exceptions
sop: Take the most frequent exceptions from the ranked log.
Record the business justification underwriters give for each.
Note whether the exception should become a rule.
Done when the frequent exceptions carry justifications.
verify: Check the top ranked exceptions for justifications.
Pass when each has a recorded justification.

steps.title: Identify rules reported as unworkable or routinely waived
sop: Ask underwriters which rules are unworkable or routinely waived.
List those rules with the reason given.
Mark each for removal or rewrite.
Done when problem rules are identified and marked.
verify: Check marked rules against the waiver evidence.
Pass when every marked rule cites evidence.

steps.title: Capture segments underwriting believes are mispriced or over-restricted
sop: Record segments underwriting considers mispriced or wrongly restricted.
Note the evidence or experience behind each view.
Route each to actuarial testing.
Done when every named segment is captured and routed.
verify: Check each named segment has a routing reference.
Pass when no segment is captured without routing.

steps.title: Circulate the consultation notes and confirm accuracy
sop: Write up the consultation notes and circulate to participants.
Ask each participant to confirm the record is accurate.
File the confirmed notes in SharePoint.
Done when participants confirm the notes.
verify: Check the confirmation responses against the participant list.
Pass when every participant has confirmed.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every guideline change decision made in this calibration cycle.
generic.In-scope period: The calibration cycle from analysis through to the approving forum decision.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Change, supporting evidence reference, options rejected and expected impact populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Rationale record count equals the number of guideline changes approved.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Rationale record versioned in the document repository against the guideline version.

generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Rationale accepted when decision maker, date and approving forum are all captured.
generic.Evidence location: Decision rationale record in the document management repository linked from SharePoint.

steps.title: List every guideline change requiring a rationale
sop: Extract the change list from the approved guideline version.
Reconcile the list to the change summary issued.
Create a rationale entry for each change.
Done when a rationale entry exists for every change.
verify: Compare rationale entries to the change list.
Pass when the counts agree.

steps.title: Reference the supporting loss ratio and volume evidence
sop: Attach the exhibit reference supporting each change.
Quote the loss ratio and volume evidence used.
Confirm the exhibit is retrievable from the analysis folder.
Done when every change cites its supporting exhibit.
verify: Follow a sample of exhibit references.
Pass when each reference resolves to the cited evidence.

steps.title: Record options considered and rejected
sop: List the alternative options considered for each change.
State why each alternative was rejected.
Include the do-nothing option where relevant.
Done when rejected options and reasons are recorded.
verify: Check each change for at least one rejected option.
Pass when no change shows a single unexamined option.

steps.title: Record where the decision differs from the actuarial recommendation
sop: Identify decisions that depart from the actuarial recommendation.
State the business rationale and the accepted risk.
Flag the entry as a departure.
Done when every departure carries a rationale and accepted risk.
verify: Filter entries on the departure flag.
Pass when every departure states the accepted risk.

steps.title: Record the expected financial impact for later testing
sop: State the expected premium and loss ratio impact of each change.
Note the period over which the impact should emerge.
Make the impact measurable at the follow-up review.
Done when every change carries a measurable expected impact.
verify: Check the impact field is numeric and time-bound.
Pass when both conditions hold for every change.

steps.title: Capture decision maker, date and approving forum
sop: Record who decided each change and on what date.
Name the approving forum for each decision.
Attach the forum minutes reference.
Done when all three fields are captured per change.
verify: Scan the three fields for blanks.
Pass when no change is missing any of them.

steps.title: File the rationale record against the guideline version
sop: Version the rationale record to match the guideline version.
File it in the document management repository.
Link it from the guideline SharePoint folder.
Done when the record is filed and linked.
verify: Follow the SharePoint link to the repository record.
Pass when the link resolves and versions match.

generic.Defined scope/population: All guideline sections being revised to incorporate actuarial recommendations.

steps.title: Log every actuarial recommendation against a draft section
sop: List the actuarial recommendations handed to drafting.
Map each to the guideline section it affects.
Mark each as to be incorporated or to be considered.
Done when every recommendation is mapped to a section.
verify: Compare the mapping to the recommendation list.
Pass when no recommendation is unmapped.

steps.title: Incorporate or explicitly decline each recommendation
sop: Draft the text for each incorporated recommendation.
Record a reason for each recommendation not adopted.
Update the mapping status for every entry.
Done when every recommendation is incorporated or declined with a reason.
verify: Filter the mapping on open status.
Pass when no recommendation remains open.

steps.title: Write target, restricted and prohibited classes as explicit lists
sop: Replace prose descriptions with named class lists.
Separate target, restricted and prohibited into three lists.
Confirm each class appears in exactly one list.
Done when all three lists are explicit and mutually exclusive.
verify: Check for classes appearing in more than one list.
Pass when no class is duplicated across lists.

steps.title: Write attachment, deductible and TIV boundaries as numeric rules
sop: Convert each boundary into a numeric rule with units.
Remove wording requiring underwriter interpretation.
Confirm the rules can be applied without judgement.
Done when every boundary is expressed numerically.
verify: Review boundary rules for interpretive wording.
Pass when none requires interpretation.

steps.title: Cross-check referral triggers against the authority matrix
sop: Compare each referral trigger in the draft to the calibrated matrix.
Correct any mismatch in threshold or scope.
Record the cross-check on the draft.
Done when triggers match the matrix exactly.
verify: Compare the two trigger sets line by line.
Pass when they match with no differences.

steps.title: Record version, author and target effective date on the cover
sop: Set the draft version number and record the author.
Add the target effective date to the cover page.
Save the draft with tracked changes enabled.
Done when the cover page carries all three fields.
verify: Open the cover page and read the three fields.
Pass when all three are populated.

steps.title: Complete the draft and submit it for committee approval
sop: Review the draft against the recommendation mapping and class lists.
Record draft completion with name and date.
Submit the draft into the committee approval step.
Done when the draft is completed and submitted.
verify: Check the submission record references the draft version.
Pass when the submitted version matches the completed draft.

generic.Defined scope/population: Bound, declined and not-taken submissions with their as-at-underwriting characteristics.

generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Dataset and reconciliation stored with the extract timestamp and version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Submissions with missing outcome or characteristics logged with disposition.

generic.Pass/fail thresholds: All three outcome types present and characteristics captured at time of underwriting.
generic.Exception handling path: Records with current-value characteristics are corrected or removed before analysis.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Dataset accepted when quote-to-bind and hit ratio are computed alongside loss ratio.
generic.Evidence location: Segmented submission dataset in the data warehouse project area with the reconciliation.

steps.title: Extract bound, declined and not-taken submissions

Retain the outcome type on each record.
Land the extract in the warehouse project area.
Done when all three outcome types are extracted.
verify: Count records by outcome type.
Pass when bound, declined and not-taken are all populated.

steps.title: Capture risk characteristics as at time of underwriting

Record the as-at date on each record.
Done when every record carries as-at-underwriting values.
verify: Compare a sample of records against the decision-time snapshot.
Pass when the sampled values match the snapshot.

steps.title: Compute quote-to-bind and hit ratio by segment
sop: Compute quote-to-bind and hit ratio for each segment.
Place the ratios beside the segment loss ratio.
Reconcile counts used to the submission extract.
Done when both ratios exist for every segment.
verify: Scan the ratio columns for blanks.
Pass when no segment is missing either ratio.

steps.title: Join referral and exception flags onto each record
sop: Join the referral and exception flags from the workstation.

Measure the unmatched flag rate.
Done when flags are joined onto every eligible record.
verify: Read the unmatched flag rate.
Pass when the rate is within the agreed tolerance.

steps.title: Isolate exception-driven business for separate analysis
sop: Filter records carrying an exception flag.
Compute their volume and loss ratio separately.
Present the exception cohort alongside the standard cohort.
Done when the exception cohort is isolated and measured.
verify: Check the exception cohort has its own volume and loss ratio.
Pass when both are reported separately.

steps.title: Reconcile bound premium to the financial ledger
sop: Compare bound submission premium to written premium in the ledger.
Record the variance and explanation.
Retain the reconciliation with the dataset.
Done when the reconciliation is complete and retained.
verify: Read the reconciliation variance.
Pass when the variance is within tolerance and explained.

steps.title: Release the segmented dataset for guideline analysis
sop: Review outcome coverage, as-at values, flags and reconciliation.
Record the release with name and date.
Notify the guideline analysis consumers.
Done when the dataset is released and consumers notified.
verify: Read the release record on the dataset.
Pass when the record confirms all three outcome types and the reconciliation.

generic.Defined scope/population: Class by territory by limit band cells assessed for profitability against target.
generic.In-scope period: At least three years of experience used to test persistence of underperformance.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Cell identifier, loss ratio, premium volume, credibility flag and dollar impact populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Cell premium totals sum to the portfolio premium for the same period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Heat map and ranked list saved with the extract date and dataset version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Cells explained by known one-off losses logged and excluded from the action list.
generic.Test population: Every populated cell in the class by territory by limit band grid.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Cells below the credibility floor are suppressed and cannot drive a decision.
generic.Exception handling path: Low-credibility cells are merged upward before any conclusion is drawn.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Segments accepted when ranked by dollar impact and confirmed persistent over three years.
generic.Evidence location: Profitability heat map in Power BI with the ranked segment list attached.

steps.title: Build the class by territory by limit band grid in the warehouse
sop: Aggregate premium and ultimate loss into the three-dimensional grid.
Reconcile grid premium to the portfolio total.
Land the aggregated grid for reporting.
Done when the grid is built and reconciled.
verify: Compare grid premium total to the portfolio total.
Pass when the two agree.

steps.title: Colour the heat map against the target loss ratio in Power BI
sop: Apply the target loss ratio as the colour midpoint.
Colour each cell by its variance to target.
Publish the heat map to the analysis workspace.
Done when the heat map is coloured against target and published.
verify: Open the heat map and check the colour scale.
Pass when the scale is anchored on the target loss ratio.

steps.title: Suppress or merge cells below the credibility floor
sop: Apply the credibility floor to every cell.
Grey out or merge cells falling below it.
Record the suppression rule on the report.
Done when all low-credibility cells are suppressed or merged.
verify: Check suppressed cells against the credibility floor.
Pass when no sub-floor cell is shown as actionable.

steps.title: Rank underperforming cells by dollar loss impact
sop: Compute the dollar impact of each underperforming cell.
Rank cells by absolute dollar impact rather than percentage.
Publish the ranked list beside the heat map.
Done when the ranked list is produced by dollar impact.
verify: Read the sort order of the ranked list.
Pass when the ordering is by dollar impact.

steps.title: Test persistence across at least three years
sop: Compare each candidate cell result across three years.
Mark as structural only where underperformance persists.
Record the persistence result per cell.
Done when persistence is tested for every candidate cell.
verify: Check structural cells for a three year persistence result.
Pass when no cell is called structural without persistence.

steps.title: Annotate cells explained by known one-off losses
sop: Identify cells driven by a single known one-off loss.
Annotate the cell and exclude it from the action list.
Reference the loss detail in the annotation.
Done when all one-off driven cells are annotated and excluded.
verify: Compare excluded cells to the large loss listing.
Pass when every exclusion cites a specific loss.

steps.title: Publish the underperforming segment list
sop: Assemble the heat map, ranked list, persistence and annotations.
Version and publish to the guideline calibration folder.
Route the list into the guideline drafting step.
Done when the list is published and routed.
verify: Open the published list and check all sections.
Pass when ranking, persistence and annotations all appear.

generic.Defined scope/population: Historical submissions re-tested against the proposed guideline rules.

generic.Evidence location: Impact model output in the guideline calibration folder with the Excel scenario workbook.

steps.title: Re-apply the proposed rules to the historical submission set
sop: Load the proposed rule set into the impact model in Earnix.
Evaluate every historical submission against the rules.
Mark each submission as retained, referred or excluded.
Done when every submission carries a rule outcome.
verify: Count submissions without an outcome.

steps.title: Quantify premium lost from newly excluded business

Reconcile excluded plus retained premium to the total.
Report the premium loss by segment.

verify: Compare excluded plus retained to the total premium.
Pass when the parts sum to the whole.

steps.title: Compute the actual loss ratio of the excluded cohort

Compare it to the portfolio target loss ratio.

Done when the excluded cohort loss ratio is computed.
verify: Check the excluded cohort has a loss ratio and a target comparison.

steps.title: Compute the net effect on portfolio loss ratio and profit
sop: Remove the excluded cohort and recompute the portfolio loss ratio.
Compute the resulting underwriting profit effect.
Report profit effect rather than premium volume alone.
Done when the net profit effect is computed.

Pass when a net profit figure is reported.

steps.title: Include the fixed expense absorption effect of lower volume
sop: Apply the fixed expense base to the reduced premium volume.
Show the expense ratio deterioration caused by lower volume.
Include the effect in the profit calculation.
Done when fixed expense absorption is included.

Pass when the line is present and non-zero where volume falls.

steps.title: Run retention and hit-ratio sensitivities in Excel
sop: Flex retention and hit ratio around the central assumption.
Produce best and worst case outcomes.
Tabulate the range beside the central case.
Done when best and worst cases are produced.
verify: Check the table shows central, best and worst cases.
Pass when all three appear.

steps.title: Publish the impact model output for the guideline decision
sop: Assemble premium loss, cohort loss ratio, profit effect and sensitivities.
Version the output against the rule set version.
Publish to the guideline calibration folder.
Done when the output is published and versioned.
verify: Open the published output and check all four sections.
Pass when every section is present.

steps.title: Define the post-change cohorts and the pre-change baseline
sop: Define cohorts by month since the guideline effective date.
Set the pre-change period as the comparison baseline.
Record both definitions on the monitoring report.
Done when cohorts and baseline are defined and recorded.
verify: Read the cohort definitions on the report.
Pass when both post-change and baseline periods are stated.

steps.title: Track new business mix by target and restricted class
sop: Compute monthly new business mix by target and restricted class.
Compare the mix to the intended post-change mix.
Highlight months deviating from intention.

verify: Check each month has a mix and an intended comparison.
Pass when no month is missing either.

steps.title: Track hit ratio and average premium for over-tightening
sop: Compute hit ratio and average premium per month.
Compare both against the baseline period.
Flag movements suggesting over-tightening or dislocation.
Done when both metrics are tracked against baseline.
verify: Scan the metric columns for blanks.

steps.title: Track referral and exception volumes against baseline

Compare volumes to the pre-change baseline.
Flag volumes exceeding referrer capacity.

verify: Check each cohort has an early frequency value.

steps.title: Compare results to the impact model prediction

Compute the variance for each metric.
Flag material variances for review.
Done when every metric has a prediction comparison.
verify: Scan the comparison for metrics without a prediction.

generic.Defined scope/population: Proposed appetite position for every class, geography and size band in the portfolio.

Restrict edit access to the filing owner.
Route any later change through re-approval.
Done when the approved version is locked.
verify: Attempt to open the package for editing.
Pass when the approved version is read-only.

steps.title: Release the approved package for submission
sop: Release the approved package to the filing specialist.
Confirm the submission window against the state review clock.
Record the release on the filing record.
Done when the package is released for submission.
verify: Compare the release date to the approval date.
Pass when release follows approval.

generic.Defined scope/population: The full filing set for each approved filing being archived for compliance.
generic.In-scope period: From regulator disposition to the end of the state retention period.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: State, line, SERFF tracking ID, effective date and disposal date populated per record.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Archived record count equals the closed filings for the cycle.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Archive entry carries the version of each document and the archive date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Missing correspondence or documents logged with the retrieval action and disposition.
generic.Test population: Every closed filing in the cycle and its complete document set.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Each archive record retrievable by state, SERFF tracking number and effective date.
generic.Exception handling path: Incomplete archives are held open until the missing documents are retrieved.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Archive accepted when access is restricted to compliance and actuarial with logging.
generic.Evidence location: Compliance evidence repository archive record linked to the document repository files.

steps.title: Assemble the full filing set for each closed filing
sop: Collect the submission package, memorandum, exhibits and correspondence.
Add objection threads and the approval or disposition letter.
Confirm nothing is missing against the filing record.
Done when the full set is assembled for every closed filing.
verify: Compare the assembled set to the filing checklist.
Pass when no document is missing.

steps.title: Index the archive record by state, line and SERFF tracking ID
sop: Create the archive record in the compliance evidence repository.
Index by state, line, SERFF tracking ID and effective date.
Confirm the record is searchable on each key.
Done when the record is indexed on all four keys.
verify: Search the repository on each index key.
Pass when the record is returned on all four.

steps.title: Apply the state retention period and record the disposal date
sop: Look up the state records retention schedule for the filing type.
Apply the retention period to the archive record.
Record the calculated disposal date.
Done when retention and disposal date are recorded.
verify: Compare the disposal date to the retention schedule.
Pass when the date matches the schedule.

steps.title: Link the final approved rate pages to the archive record
sop: Attach the final approved rate pages to the archive record.
Confirm the pages match the approved filing version.
Record the link so the filed-rate position is evidenced.
Done when the approved rate pages are linked.
verify: Open the linked rate pages from the archive.
Pass when they match the approved filing version.

steps.title: Restrict access to compliance and actuarial groups
sop: Set access permissions to the compliance and actuarial groups.
Enable access logging on the archive record.
Confirm no open access remains.
Done when access is restricted and logging is enabled.
verify: Check the permission list and logging setting.
Pass when access is restricted and logging is on.

steps.title: Reconcile archived records to the closed filing list
sop: Compare archived records to the closed filings for the cycle.
Chase any filing not yet archived.
Record the reconciliation result.
Done when every closed filing has an archive record.
verify: Compare the two counts.
Pass when they are equal.

steps.title: Review and confirm the archive is exam-ready
sop: Sample archive records and test retrieval by each index key.
Confirm documents open and match the filing.
Record the review with name and date.
Done when the archive review is recorded.
verify: Retrieve a sampled record end to end.
Pass when the sampled record is complete and retrievable.

generic.Defined scope/population: The standard exhibit set supporting the rate filing for each state and line.
generic.In-scope period: The experience period and evaluation date used in the approved indication.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Experience, development, trend, expense, rate history and dislocation exhibits populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Every exhibit figure traces to the approved indication workbook without retyping.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Exhibit package versioned in the document repository with the workbook version cited.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Figures that cannot be traced logged and corrected before the package is issued.
generic.Test population: All numbered exhibits in the package for each state and line.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Exhibit numbering matches the references used in the actuarial memorandum.
generic.Exception handling path: Untraceable figures are rebuilt from the workbook rather than manually corrected.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Package accepted when the dislocation exhibit shows the maximum policyholder increase.
generic.Evidence location: Assembled exhibit package in the document repository linked to the SERFF filing.

steps.title: Assemble the standard exhibit set in Excel
sop: Build experience by year, development, trend and expense exhibits.
Add rate level history and the rate change summary.
Number each exhibit in the standard sequence.
Done when all six standard exhibits are assembled and numbered.
verify: Count the exhibits against the standard list.
Pass when none is missing.

steps.title: Link every exhibit figure to the approved indication workbook
sop: Link exhibit cells to the approved workbook rather than retyping.
Record the workbook version used.
Test the links refresh correctly.
Done when every figure is linked rather than typed.
verify: Sample exhibit cells and check the link source.
Pass when the sampled cells trace to the workbook.

steps.title: Build the rate change summary with premium weights
sop: Show overall, by-coverage and by-territory change.
Include the premium weight behind each roll-up.
Reconcile the weighted changes to the overall change.
Done when the rate change summary is complete and reconciled.
verify: Compare weighted segment changes to the overall change.
Pass when they reconcile within rounding.

steps.title: Produce the dislocation exhibit
sop: Bucket policyholder impacts into bands.
Show the distribution and the maximum increase.
Reconcile the policy count to the in-force book.
Done when the dislocation exhibit shows the distribution and maximum.
verify: Read the maximum increase figure.
Pass when the maximum and the distribution are both shown.

steps.title: Match exhibit numbering to the memorandum references
sop: Compare exhibit numbers to the references in the memorandum.
Correct any mismatch in either document.
Record the cross-check.
Done when numbering matches the memorandum references.
verify: Follow each memorandum reference to its exhibit.
Pass when every reference resolves correctly.

steps.title: Run the traceability check across the package
sop: Sample figures across every exhibit and trace them to the workbook.
Record the trace results in a check sheet.
Correct any figure that fails.
Done when the traceability check is complete with no failures.
verify: Read the traceability check sheet.
Pass when no sampled figure fails the trace.

steps.title: Review and release the exhibit package
sop: Review exhibits, weights, dislocation and traceability.
Version the package and record the review.
Release it into the filing assembly step.
Done when the package is reviewed and released.
verify: Open the released package and check the review record.
Pass when the reviewer name and date are present.

generic.Defined scope/population: State-specific filing templates for every state and line in the filing scope.
generic.In-scope period: The filing preparation window before submission to each state.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Type of insurance, sub-TOI, filing type, rate change and company details populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Rate change percentages in the template match the exhibit package digit for digit.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Completed templates saved in SERFF with a local copy and version in the repository.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: State-specific supplements not applicable logged with the reason and disposition.
generic.Test population: Every state and line template required by the filing scope list.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Correct TOI and sub-TOI selected for every state and line.
generic.Exception handling path: Templates failing the state handbook check are corrected before submission.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Templates accepted when company codes, NAIC number and contacts are verified as current.
generic.Evidence location: SERFF filing drafts with the local template copies in the filing folder.

steps.title: Select the correct type of insurance and filing type per state
sop: Choose the SERFF type of insurance and sub-TOI for each state and line.
Select the filing type appropriate to the change.
Record the selections on the filing record.
Done when TOI, sub-TOI and filing type are set for every state.
verify: Compare selections to the state filing handbook.
Pass when each matches the handbook guidance.

steps.title: Complete the state-required forms
sop: Complete the rate and rule schedule and the transmittal form.
Complete the actuarial certification field and any state supplement.
Note supplements that do not apply with the reason.
Done when all required forms are completed for every state.
verify: Check each state against its required form list.
Pass when no required form is incomplete.

steps.title: Enter rate change percentages reconciled to the exhibits
sop: Enter overall and by-coverage rate change percentages.
Reconcile each entry digit for digit against the exhibit package.
Correct any mismatch in the template.
Done when every entered percentage reconciles to the exhibits.
verify: Compare entered percentages to the exhibit values.
Pass when they match exactly.

steps.title: Check state-specific requirements against the filing handbook
sop: Check prior approval versus file-and-use timelines for each state.
Check any state-specific data or notice requirement.
Record the handbook reference used.
Done when every state has a handbook check recorded.
verify: Read the handbook reference on each state record.
Pass when every state carries a reference.

steps.title: Verify company codes, NAIC number and contacts
sop: Check the filing entity company codes and NAIC number are current.
Verify the filing contact name, phone and email.
Update anything out of date before finalising.
Done when all company and contact details are verified.
verify: Compare details to the current licence register.
Pass when all details match the register.

steps.title: Save the completed templates locally with a version
sop: Export or copy each completed template to the filing folder.
Version the copies with the filing cycle identifier.
Link the copies from the filing record.
Done when versioned local copies exist for every template.
verify: Open a sample local copy from the filing record.
Pass when the copy matches the SERFF draft.

steps.title: Review the completed templates before submission
sop: Review TOI selections, forms, percentages and contact details.
Record the review with name and date.
Release the templates into the submission step.
Done when the review is recorded and templates released.
verify: Read the review record on the filing.
Pass when a reviewer name and date are present.

generic.Defined scope/population: Approved rate pages and rating tables being implemented in the policy system.
generic.In-scope period: From regulator approval to confirmed production go-live for each state.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Rate table values, effective dates, capping rules and verification results populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Loaded rating tables diff clean against the filed rate pages line by line.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Implementation record saved with the release version and go-live confirmation.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Diff differences logged as defects with severity and disposition.
generic.Test population: Every rate table and rule loaded for the approved filing.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No rate applied in production ahead of its filed effective date.
generic.Exception handling path: Diff failures block go-live until the tables are corrected and re-diffed.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Implementation accepted when production rating verification confirms filed rates apply.
generic.Evidence location: Implementation record in the filing folder with the diff output and go-live confirmation.

steps.title: Hand the approved rate pages to product and IT
sop: Provide the approved rate pages with exact new and renewal effective dates.
Confirm the scope of tables and rules to be loaded.
Record the handover on the implementation record.
Done when the rate pages and dates are handed over.
verify: Check the handover record for both effective dates.
Pass when both dates are recorded.

steps.title: Load the rating tables into the policy system
sop: Load the approved rating tables into Guidewire PolicyCenter and Earnix.
Apply the configured effective dates.
Record the release version loaded.
Done when the tables are loaded with effective dates applied.
verify: Check the loaded table version against the release record.
Pass when the versions agree.

steps.title: Diff the loaded tables against the filed rate pages
sop: Run a line by line diff of loaded values against the filed rate pages.
Log every difference as a defect.
Re-diff after each correction.
Done when the diff returns no differences.
verify: Read the diff output.
Pass when the diff is clean.

steps.title: Configure renewal capping and transition rules as filed
sop: Configure the filed renewal capping percentage and transition period.
Test the capping on sample renewal policies.
Record the configuration against the filing.
Done when capping and transition rules are configured as filed.
verify: Compare the configured rules to the filed text.
Pass when the configuration matches the filing.

steps.title: Run production rating verification on sample quotes
sop: Rate sample quotes in production after go-live.
Compare the rated premium to the expected filed rates.
Log any difference immediately.
Done when the production verification is run and results recorded.
verify: Compare production premiums to the expected values.
Pass when the sampled quotes rate as filed.

steps.title: Confirm no rate applies ahead of its filed effective date
sop: Check the system effective dating on each loaded table.
Test a quote dated before the effective date.
Correct any early application immediately.
Done when the effective dating is confirmed correct.
verify: Rate a pre-effective-date quote.
Pass when the old rates apply for that date.

steps.title: Record written go-live confirmation against the filing
sop: Obtain written go-live confirmation from product and IT.
Store the confirmation with the filing record.
Update the filing status to implemented.
Done when the go-live confirmation is stored.
verify: Open the filing record and read the status.
Pass when the status is implemented with the confirmation attached.

generic.Defined scope/population: Regulator dispositions received for every submitted filing in the cycle.
generic.In-scope period: From regulator decision to closure of the filing tracker entry.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Disposition, approved effective date, conditions and disposition document populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Recorded dispositions equal the filings reaching a decision in the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Regulator letter attached to the filing record with the disposition date recorded.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Approved dates differing from the requested date logged and flagged to product.
generic.Test population: Every filing with a regulator decision in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every disposition recorded per state and per filing number with its document attached.
generic.Exception handling path: Conditions imposed by the regulator are routed to the implementation owner immediately.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Decision accepted when the tracker is closed and downstream implementation is released.
generic.Evidence location: Filing record in the regulatory tracker with the SERFF disposition document attached.

steps.title: Retrieve the disposition from the regulator portal
sop: Check SERFF for the disposition on each open filing.
Download the disposition document.
Record the disposition date.
Done when the disposition is retrieved for each decided filing.
verify: Compare retrieved dispositions to the open filing list.
Pass when every decided filing has a retrieved disposition.

steps.title: Record the disposition per state and filing number
sop: Record approved, approved with conditions, withdrawn or disapproved per filing.
Enter the disposition against the state and filing number.
Leave no decided filing without a recorded disposition.
Done when every decided filing carries a disposition.
verify: Scan the tracker for decided filings without a disposition.
Pass when none is found.

steps.title: Record the approved effective date and compare to the request
sop: Record the effective date approved by the regulator.
Compare it to the requested effective date.
Flag differences to product management.
Done when the approved date is recorded and compared.
verify: Read the date comparison field.
Pass when differences are flagged to product.

steps.title: Capture regulator conditions and route them to implementation
sop: Extract any conditions or restrictions from the disposition.
Record each condition on the filing record.
Route each to the implementation owner with a due date.
Done when every condition is recorded and routed.
verify: Check conditions for a routing reference and owner.
Pass when none is unrouted.

steps.title: Attach the disposition document to the filing record
sop: Attach the regulator letter or SERFF disposition to the filing record.
Confirm the attachment opens correctly.
Record the attachment date.
Done when the disposition document is attached.
verify: Open the attached document from the filing record.
Pass when it opens and matches the disposition.

steps.title: Update the filing tracker status to closed
sop: Set the tracker status to closed for the decided filing.
Record the closing date and the responsible specialist.
Confirm no open objections remain on the filing.
Done when the tracker entry is closed.
verify: Read the tracker status and open objection count.
Pass when the status is closed with no open objections.

steps.title: Release the downstream implementation task
sop: Confirm the disposition and conditions with the implementation owner.
Release the implementation task with the approved effective date.
Record the release on the filing record.
Done when the implementation task is released.
verify: Check the implementation task carries the approved effective date.
Pass when the dates agree.

generic.Defined scope/population: The actuarial memorandum supporting the rate filing for each state and line.
generic.In-scope period: The experience period, evaluation date and proposed effective period of the filing.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Purpose, scope, data sources, methodology and signing actuary block populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Rate change figures in the memorandum reconcile to the numbered exhibits.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Memorandum versioned in the document repository with the exhibit package version cited.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Data exclusions and limitations logged in the memorandum with their effect.
generic.Test population: Every section of the memorandum and every exhibit cross-reference.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every rate figure cross-referenced to a numbered exhibit a reviewer can follow.
generic.Exception handling path: Unsupported figures are removed or supported before the memorandum is finalised.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Memorandum accepted when qualification, reliances and limitations are stated per ASOP.
generic.Evidence location: Actuarial memorandum in the document repository attached to the SERFF filing.

steps.title: State purpose, scope, effective date and the rate change
sop: Write the filing purpose and the scope of lines and coverages.
State the proposed effective date and the overall and by-coverage change.
Confirm the figures against the approved indication.
Done when purpose, scope, date and change are stated.
verify: Compare the stated change to the approved indication.
Pass when the figures agree.

steps.title: Describe data sources, experience period and exclusions
sop: Describe the source systems, experience period and evaluation date.
State every data exclusion applied and its effect.
Reference the released experience extract version.
Done when data sources and exclusions are described.
verify: Read the data section for source, period and exclusions.
Pass when all three appear.

steps.title: Explain each methodology step in sequence
sop: Explain on-level, development, trend, credibility, expense and profit provision.
Keep the explanation in the order the calculation runs.
Reference the exhibit supporting each step.
Done when every methodology step is explained and referenced.
verify: Check each step has an exhibit reference.
Pass when no step is unreferenced.

steps.title: Cross-reference the rate change support to numbered exhibits
sop: Cross-reference every rate figure to its numbered exhibit.
Confirm the exhibit numbers match the assembled package.
Test that a reviewer can follow each figure to source.
Done when every figure carries an exhibit reference.
verify: Follow a sample of references to the exhibits.
Pass when each resolves to the cited figure.

steps.title: Include the qualification statement and reliances
sop: Insert the qualification statement for the signing actuary.
List reliances on other parties by name and scope.
State the limitations of the analysis.
Done when qualification, reliances and limitations are included.
verify: Read the ASOP compliance section.
Pass when all three elements appear.

steps.title: Add the signing actuary block
sop: Add the signing actuary name, credentials and signature block.
Leave a date field for signature at certification.
Confirm the signer meets the qualification standard.
Done when the signing block is in place.
verify: Read the signing block.
Pass when name, credentials and date field are present.

steps.title: Review the memorandum before certification
sop: Review scope, data, methodology, references and ASOP sections.
Return gaps to the drafter for completion.
Record the review with name and date.
Done when the review is recorded with no open gaps.
verify: Read the review record.
Pass when the record shows no open gaps.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every state and line where a rate or form filing may be required for this change.
generic.In-scope period: The filing cycle from scope definition to submission planning.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Filing requirement type, threshold check, lead time and source citation populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Scope list covers every licensed state writing the affected line.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Scope list versioned in the filing tracker with the licence register extract date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: States omitted from the scope logged with a documented reason and disposition.
generic.Test population: All licensed states and lines affected by the rate change.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No licensed state writing the affected line omitted without a documented reason.
generic.Exception handling path: States where the requirement is unclear are escalated to Compliance for a ruling.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Scope accepted when lead times allow the target effective date to be met.
generic.Evidence location: Filing scope list in the regulatory filing tracker with the licence register extract.

steps.title: Confirm licensed states writing the affected line
sop: Extract the licence register for the affected lines.
Confirm which states are actively writing the business.
Build the candidate state and line list.
Done when the candidate list covers every licensed writing state.
verify: Compare the list to the licence register.
Pass when no licensed writing state is missing.

steps.title: Classify the filing requirement per state
sop: Classify each state as prior approval, file-and-use, use-and-file, flex band or exempt.
Cite the statutory or handbook source for each classification.
Record the classification on the scope list.
Done when every state carries a classified requirement with a citation.
verify: Check each classification for a citation.
Pass when none is uncited.

steps.title: Check the change against state flex bands and thresholds
sop: Compare the proposed change to each state flex band or threshold.
Determine whether a filing is triggered at all.
Record the threshold check result per state.
Done when the threshold check is recorded for every state.
verify: Read the threshold check column.
Pass when every state has a recorded result.

steps.title: Identify accompanying form and rule changes
sop: List form and rule changes accompanying the rate change.
Determine the correct filing type for the combination.
Record the filing type per state.
Done when accompanying changes and filing types are identified.
verify: Compare the filing type to the change content.
Pass when the type matches the changes being filed.

steps.title: Record filing lead times and review clocks
sop: Record the statutory review clock and practical lead time per state.
Back-plan submission dates from the target effective date.
Flag states where the effective date is unachievable.
Done when lead times and submission dates are recorded.
verify: Compare submission dates to the target effective date.
Pass when every state either fits or is flagged.

steps.title: Document reasons for any state excluded from the scope
sop: List states excluded from the filing scope.
Record the reason for each exclusion.
Escalate exclusions where the reason is uncertain.
Done when every exclusion carries a documented reason.
verify: Scan exclusions for missing reasons.
Pass when none is undocumented.

steps.title: Publish the filing scope list in the tracker
sop: Load the scope list into the regulatory filing tracker.
Version the list with the licence register extract date.
Release it to the filing preparation step.
Done when the scope list is published and released.
verify: Open the tracker entry and check the version.
Pass when the published list carries the extract date and version.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every approved filing with an effective date still to be implemented.
generic.In-scope period: From regulator approval to the confirmed go-live of each approved filing.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: New business date, renewal date, implementation status and readiness flag populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Tracked filings equal the approved filings not yet implemented.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Tracker entries carry a last-checked date and the source portal reference.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Filings whose approved date slipped past the requested date logged with a re-plan.
generic.Test population: All approved filings awaiting or undergoing implementation.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every approved filing carries recorded new business and renewal effective dates.
generic.Exception handling path: Implementation tasks not complete within the agreed buffer trigger an alert to product.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Monitoring accepted when readiness status is visible against every upcoming date.
generic.Evidence location: Regulatory filing tracker entries with the SERFF approval references.

steps.title: Record new and renewal effective dates for every approved filing
sop: Enter the approved new business and renewal effective dates in the tracker.
Take the dates from the SERFF disposition rather than memory.
Record the last-checked date.
Done when both dates are recorded for every approved filing.
verify: Scan the tracker for filings missing either date.
Pass when none is missing.

steps.title: Check upcoming dates against the policy system release calendar
sop: Compare each effective date to the system release calendar.
Identify conflicts with planned releases.
Raise conflicts with the release manager.
Done when every upcoming date has been checked for conflict.
verify: Read the conflict check column.
Pass when every upcoming date carries a check result.

steps.title: Back-plan renewal advance notice lead time
sop: Take the state advance notice requirement for renewals.
Back-plan the notice date from the renewal effective date.
Record the notice date in the tracker.
Done when notice dates are back-planned for every filing.
verify: Compare the notice date to the state requirement.
Pass when the lead time meets or exceeds the requirement.

steps.title: Re-plan filings whose approved date slipped
sop: Identify filings where the approved date is later than requested.
Re-plan implementation with product and IT.
Record the revised plan on the tracker entry.
Done when every slipped filing has a revised plan.
verify: Check slipped filings for a revised plan.
Pass when none is left unplanned.

steps.title: Record implementation readiness per filing
sop: Record whether rate tables are loaded and tested for each filing.
Set the readiness flag on the tracker entry.
Update the flag as implementation progresses.
Done when a readiness flag is set for every filing.
verify: Scan the readiness flags for blanks.
Pass when every filing carries a flag.

steps.title: Raise alerts where readiness lags the agreed buffer
sop: Compare readiness status to the agreed buffer before go-live.
Raise an alert to the implementation owner where the buffer is breached.
Record the alert and the response.
Done when alerts are raised for every buffer breach.
verify: Check buffer breaches for a raised alert.
Pass when none is unalerted.

steps.title: Review the effective date tracker each cycle
sop: Review dates, readiness and alerts across all approved filings.
Record the review with name and date.
Escalate any filing at risk of missing its date.
Done when the tracker review is recorded.
verify: Read the review record on the tracker.
Pass when a reviewer name and date are present for the cycle.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every contested assumption and regulator concern on the filings under negotiation.
generic.In-scope period: From the first regulator challenge to the confirmed negotiated outcome.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Contact date, regulator name, channel, concern and position offered populated per entry.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Log entries cover every regulator contact on the filing with none omitted.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Negotiation log stored with the filing record and dated per contact.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Agreed reductions to the rate change logged with the adequacy gap and disposition.
generic.Test population: All regulator contacts and all contested assumptions on the filing.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Final negotiated position confirmed in writing through the filing portal.
generic.Exception handling path: Positions beyond the internal walk-away point are escalated to the Chief Actuary.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Negotiation accepted when fallback positions were agreed internally before contact.
generic.Evidence location: Negotiation log filed with the filing record in the document repository.

steps.title: Record regulator concerns verbatim with contact details
sop: Write each regulator concern in the words used by the regulator.
Record the date, name and channel of the contact.
Log each concern as a separate entry.
Done when every concern is logged verbatim with contact details.
verify: Check each log entry for date, name and channel.
Pass when all three are recorded on every entry.

steps.title: Agree fallback positions and the walk-away point internally
sop: Agree reduced change, phased implementation and capped renewal fallbacks.
Set the walk-away point before any negotiation contact.
Record the agreed positions in the negotiation plan.
Done when fallbacks and the walk-away point are agreed.
verify: Compare the plan date to the first negotiation contact.
Pass when the plan predates the first contact.

steps.title: Prepare additional actuarial support per contested assumption
sop: Prepare new analysis for each contested assumption.
Avoid restating the original argument without new evidence.
Attach the support to the response.
Done when every contested assumption has new supporting analysis.
verify: Check each contested assumption for new analysis.
Pass when none relies only on the original argument.

steps.title: Present the position to the regulator through the portal
sop: Submit the position and supporting analysis through SERFF.
Record the submission date and content in the log.
Avoid concluding any position by phone alone.
Done when the position is submitted through the portal.
verify: Check the portal record for the submitted position.
Pass when the position appears in the portal history.

steps.title: Quantify any agreed reduction against the indication
sop: Compute the gap between the agreed change and the indicated change.
Document the resulting adequacy shortfall.
Record the shortfall for portfolio monitoring.
Done when every agreed reduction is quantified.
verify: Read the adequacy gap figure.
Pass when the gap is quantified for each reduction.

steps.title: Escalate positions beyond the walk-away point
sop: Identify demands exceeding the agreed walk-away point.
Escalate for a decision on withdrawal or acceptance.
Record the escalation and the decision.
Done when every out-of-mandate demand is escalated.
verify: Check escalations for a recorded decision.
Pass when none is left open.

steps.title: Confirm the final negotiated position in writing
sop: Confirm the final position through the filing portal in writing.
Store the confirmation with the filing record.
Update the negotiation log to closed.
Done when the negotiated outcome is confirmed in writing.
verify: Open the portal confirmation from the filing record.
Pass when the written confirmation matches the agreed position.

generic.Defined scope/population: The actuarial certification required for each filing and state in the cycle.
generic.In-scope period: From exhibit lock to certification signature and filing submission.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Signer name, qualification, certification wording and signature date populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Certifications on file equal the filings where the state mandates one.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Signed certification attached to the filing package with the signed original archived.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: States where certification wording differs logged with the wording applied.
generic.Test population: Every filing in the cycle requiring a certification.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No filing submitted lacking the required certification where the state mandates one.
generic.Exception handling path: Certifications dated before exhibit lock are re-signed before submission.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Certification accepted when the signer meets the qualification standard for the statement.
generic.Evidence location: Signed certification in the filing package with the original in the document repository.

steps.title: Confirm the signing actuary meets the qualification standard
sop: Check the signer credentials against the qualification standard for the statement.
Record the qualification basis on the filing record.
Choose an alternative signer where the standard is not met.
Done when a qualified signer is confirmed for every filing.
verify: Read the recorded qualification basis.
Pass when the signer meets the stated standard.

steps.title: Match the certification wording to the state prescription
sop: Take the state-prescribed certification wording for the line and filing type.
Apply the exact wording to the certification.
Log any state where the wording differs from the standard text.
Done when the wording matches the state prescription.
verify: Compare the certification text to the state prescription.
Pass when the wording matches exactly.

steps.title: Include the not excessive, inadequate or unfairly discriminatory statement
sop: Add the required statement where the state mandates it.
Confirm the statement covers the filed rates in scope.
Record which states require the statement.
Done when the statement is included wherever required.
verify: Check mandated states for the statement.
Pass when it is present in every state that requires it.

steps.title: Lock the final exhibits before certification
sop: Freeze the exhibit package version to be certified.
Record the lock date and version.
Prevent further edits to the locked package.
Done when the exhibits are locked and dated.
verify: Check the exhibit lock date and edit permissions.
Pass when the package is locked and read-only.

steps.title: Obtain the appointed actuary signature
sop: Review the memorandum and locked exhibits.
Sign the certification and record the signature date.
Note any reservation attached to the signature.
Done when the certification is signed and dated.
verify: Compare the signature date to the exhibit lock date.
Pass when the signature follows the lock and precedes submission.

steps.title: Attach the signed certification to the filing package
sop: Attach the signed certification to the SERFF package.
Confirm the attachment opens and is legible.
Record the attachment on the filing record.
Done when the signed certification is attached to the package.
verify: Open the attached certification in the package.
Pass when it opens and carries the signature.

steps.title: Archive the signed original in the document repository
sop: Store the signed original in the document management repository.
Index it against the filing and state.
Confirm it is retrievable for examination.
Done when the signed original is archived and indexed.
verify: Retrieve the original from the repository by filing reference.
Pass when the retrieval returns the signed original.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every regulator objection item raised against the filings in this cycle.
generic.In-scope period: From objection receipt to the portal-confirmed response for each item.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Objection item, state deadline, assigned responder, response and evidence populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Logged objection items equal the items raised in the regulator correspondence.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Objection log and revised exhibits version-controlled with the portal receipt attached.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Extensions requested from the regulator logged with the granted date and disposition.
generic.Test population: All objection items across all open filings.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No objection past its regulator-set deadline without a documented extension.
generic.Exception handling path: Rate or exhibit revisions arising from objections go back through internal re-approval.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Responses accepted when each answers the specific question with cited support.
generic.Evidence location: Objection log in the regulatory filing tracker with SERFF submission receipts.

steps.title: Log each objection item separately with its deadline
sop: Split the regulator correspondence into individual objection items.
Record the state response deadline for each item.
Assign a responder to each item.
Done when every item is logged with a deadline and responder.
verify: Compare the logged items to the correspondence.
Pass when every raised item appears once in the log.

steps.title: Draft a response answering each specific question
sop: Answer the specific question asked rather than restating the filing.
Cite the exhibit or new analysis supporting the answer.
Keep one response per objection item.
Done when every item has a drafted response with a citation.
verify: Check each response for a specific answer and a citation.
Pass when none is generic or uncited.

steps.title: Produce new analysis where the objection requires it
sop: Identify objections that cannot be answered from existing exhibits.
Produce the additional analysis required.
Number the new exhibit into the package sequence.
Done when new analysis exists for every such objection.
verify: Check new exhibits are numbered into the package.
Pass when each new exhibit carries a sequence number.

steps.title: Re-approve internally any change to rates, rules or exhibits
sop: Identify revisions to rates, rules or exhibits arising from objections.
Route each through internal re-approval before refiling.
Record the re-approval against the revised version.
Done when every revision carries a recorded re-approval.
verify: Check revisions for a re-approval record.
Pass when none is refiled without re-approval.

steps.title: Version-control the revised exhibit package
sop: Version the revised exhibits and label the package as amended.
Retain the superseded version for the record.
Confirm the regulator receives a clearly labelled amended package.
Done when the amended package is versioned and labelled.
verify: Open the amended package and read the version label.
Pass when the amendment is clearly labelled.

steps.title: File the response through the portal before the deadline
sop: Submit each response through SERFF before its deadline.
Download and retain the submission receipt.
Update the objection log status.
Done when every response is filed with a retained receipt.
verify: Compare submission dates to the deadlines.
Pass when no response was filed late without a documented extension.

steps.title: Close the objection log when all items are cleared
sop: Confirm the regulator has accepted each response.
Close each objection item on the log.
Record the closure with name and date.
Done when every objection item is closed.
verify: Read the objection log status.
Pass when no item remains open on a cleared filing.

generic.Defined scope/population: The next rate review cycle scheduled per state and line.
generic.In-scope period: From the current filing closure to the next scheduled review date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Next review date, evaluation date, named actuary, reviewer and triggers populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Scheduled entries cover every state and line in the current review scope.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Pricing calendar entry versioned in SharePoint with the scheduling date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: States where the statutory interval constrains the date logged with disposition.
generic.Test population: Every state and line requiring a next review cycle entry.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No state scheduled beyond its statutory maximum interval between reviews.
generic.Exception handling path: Interim monitoring triggers pull the review forward when adequacy or A versus E breaches.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Schedule accepted when each entry names an actuary and a reviewer with dates.
generic.Evidence location: Pricing calendar entries in SharePoint linked from the regulatory filing tracker.

steps.title: Set the next review date per state within the statutory interval
sop: Take the statutory maximum interval between reviews for each state.
Set the next review date within that interval.
Record the interval basis on the calendar entry.
Done when a next review date is set for every state.
verify: Compare each date to the statutory interval.
Pass when no state exceeds its maximum interval.

steps.title: Back-plan the review from the target effective date
sop: Take the state review clock and system release lead times.
Back-plan the review start from the target effective date.
Record the resulting start date.
Done when the review start is back-planned for every state.
verify: Compare the start date to the total lead time.
Pass when the plan leaves sufficient lead time.

steps.title: Set the data evaluation date for the next cycle
sop: Choose an evaluation date allowing sufficient new experience to emerge.
Record the date on the calendar entry.
Confirm it aligns with the reserving evaluation cycle.
Done when the evaluation date is set and aligned.
verify: Compare the evaluation date to the reserving cycle.
Pass when the two align.

steps.title: Assign a named actuary and reviewer per state and line
sop: Assign a preparing actuary and an independent reviewer to each entry.
Confirm availability against the planned dates.
Record the names on the calendar entry.
Done when every entry names an actuary and a reviewer.
verify: Scan the entries for unassigned roles.
Pass when no entry lacks either role.

steps.title: Define interim monitoring triggers that pull the review forward
sop: Define adequacy breach and adverse A versus E as early triggers.
State the numeric threshold for each trigger.
Record the triggers on the calendar entry.
Done when every entry carries numeric early triggers.
verify: Read the trigger thresholds.
Pass when each is numeric and testable.

steps.title: Load the schedule into the pricing calendar and tracker
sop: Create the calendar entries in SharePoint.
Link each entry from the regulatory filing tracker.
Notify the assigned actuaries and reviewers.
Done when entries are loaded, linked and notified.
verify: Follow the tracker link to the calendar entry.
Pass when the link resolves for every state.

steps.title: Review and approve the next-cycle schedule
sop: Review dates, assignments, evaluation dates and triggers.
Record approval with name and date.
Publish the schedule to the pricing team.
Done when the schedule is approved and published.
verify: Open the published schedule and check the approval block.
Pass when the approver name and date are present.

generic.Defined scope/population: The complete filing package submitted to each state insurance department.
generic.In-scope period: The submission window allowing the state review clock to run before the effective date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Transmittal, rate pages, memorandum, certification and exhibit files all attached.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Documents uploaded equal the documents on the approved package manifest.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Submission confirmation and SERFF tracking number archived with the package.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Failed uploads or rejected submissions logged with the corrective disposition.
generic.Test population: Every state submission made in this filing cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No required document missing from any submitted package.
generic.Exception handling path: Submissions rejected by the portal are corrected and resubmitted before the deadline.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Submission accepted when the SERFF tracking number is written back to the tracker.
generic.Evidence location: SERFF submission record with the confirmation archived in the document repository.

steps.title: Upload the complete package to the filing portal
sop: Upload the transmittal, rate and rule pages and all numbered exhibits.
Upload the actuarial memorandum and the signed certification.
Check each upload against the package manifest.
Done when every manifest item is uploaded.
verify: Compare uploaded documents to the manifest.
Pass when no manifest item is missing.

steps.title: Pay the filing fee and record the payment reference
sop: Pay the state filing fee where one is required.
Record the payment reference on the filing record.
Note states where no fee applies.
Done when fees are paid and references recorded.
verify: Check fee-bearing states for a payment reference.
Pass when none is missing.

steps.title: Check the submission timing against the state review clock
sop: Compare the submission date to the state statutory review period.
Confirm the clock can run before the target effective date.
Escalate where the timing is too tight.
Done when the timing check is recorded for every state.
verify: Compare the submission date plus review clock to the effective date.
Pass when the clock completes before the effective date.

steps.title: Submit the filing and capture the tracking number
sop: Submit the package through the portal.
Capture the SERFF tracking number returned.
Record the submission timestamp.
Done when the filing is submitted and the tracking number captured.
verify: Read the tracking number on the filing record.
Pass when a tracking number is recorded for every submission.

steps.title: Write the tracking number back to the internal tracker
sop: Enter the SERFF tracking number into the internal filing tracker.
Link the tracker entry to the portal filing.
Set the tracker status to submitted.
Done when the tracking number is written back and linked.
verify: Follow the tracker link to the portal filing.
Pass when the link resolves to the correct filing.

steps.title: Archive the submission confirmation with the package
sop: Download the submission confirmation from the portal.
Archive it with the filing package in the document repository.
Record the archive reference on the tracker.
Done when the confirmation is archived with the package.
verify: Open the archived confirmation.
Pass when it opens and matches the submitted filing.

steps.title: Verify the submitted package completeness after submission
sop: Open the submitted filing in the portal and list the attached documents.
Compare the list to the required document set.
Submit any missing document immediately as an addendum.
Done when the submitted package is verified complete.
verify: Compare the portal document list to the required set.
Pass when memorandum, certification and rate pages are all present.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every open filing submitted and awaiting a regulator decision.
generic.In-scope period: From submission to disposition for each open filing.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Status, last-checked date, days in review, deemer date and objection deadlines populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Tracked open filings equal the submitted filings without a recorded disposition.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Tracker entries carry the last-checked date and the portal as the source.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Filings approaching a deemer or effective date logged and escalated with disposition.
generic.Test population: All open filings across every state in the cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No open filing without a status refresh within the agreed cadence.
generic.Exception handling path: Filings past the agreed refresh cadence are escalated to the filing owner.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Tracking accepted when status is pulled from the portal rather than from memory or email.
generic.Evidence location: Regulatory filing tracker entries referencing the SERFF filing records.

steps.title: Refresh the status of every open filing from the portal
sop: Open each filing in SERFF and read the current status.
Update the tracker with submitted, under review, objection raised or decided.
Record the last-checked date on each entry.
Done when every open filing has a refreshed status.
verify: Scan the last-checked dates.
Pass when every open filing was checked within the agreed cadence.

steps.title: Compute days in review against the statutory period
sop: Compute elapsed days in review for each filing.
Compare against the state statutory review period.
Record the remaining days on the tracker.
Done when days in review are computed for every filing.
verify: Check the days in review column.
Pass when every open filing carries a computed value.

steps.title: Flag deemer dates on the tracker
sop: Calculate the deemer date for each state where one applies.
Record the deemer date on the tracker entry.
Flag filings approaching the deemer date.
Done when deemer dates are recorded and flagged where applicable.
verify: Compare deemer dates to the state rules.
Pass when each deemer date matches the state rule.

steps.title: Show open objections and their response deadlines
sop: Link open objections to their filing entries.
Show each response deadline on the tracker.
Highlight deadlines within the next week.
Done when open objections and deadlines are visible on the tracker.
verify: Compare tracker objections to the objection log.
Pass when the two agree.

steps.title: Escalate filings approaching the deemer or effective date
sop: Identify filings nearing the deemer date or the target effective date.
Escalate each to the filing owner with the risk stated.
Record the escalation and the response.
Done when every at-risk filing is escalated.
verify: Check at-risk filings for an escalation record.
Pass when none is unescalated.

steps.title: Reconcile the open filing list to submitted filings
sop: Compare tracked open filings to submitted filings without a disposition.
Add any missing filing to the tracker.
Close entries where a disposition has been recorded.
Done when the tracker matches the true open filing population.
verify: Compare the two counts.
Pass when the counts agree.

steps.title: Review the tracker at the agreed cadence
sop: Review statuses, deemer dates, objections and escalations.
Record the review with name and date.
Direct follow-up actions to the filing specialist.
Done when the tracker review is recorded for the cycle.
verify: Read the review record on the tracker.
Pass when a reviewer name and date are recorded for the period.
